at_a_glance: Phở bò is Vietnam’s best-known noodle soup: clear, fragrant beef broth, soft rice noodles, and thin slices of beef finished with herbs. It feels light, comforting, and deeply satisfying.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | sliced beef | herbs | lime
good_to_know: Herbs, lime, chili, and bean sprouts usually arrive on the side. Add them little by little so the broth stays balanced.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of beef noodle soup.

at_a_glance: A gentler cousin of beef phở, with clear chicken broth, rice noodles, herbs, lime, and tender slices or shreds of gà.
usually_includes: broth | rice noodles | chicken | herbs | lime
good_to_know: Ask for no chili sauce if you want the bowl mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of chicken noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Phở tái is beef phở with very thin rare beef slices that finish cooking in the hot broth. It is clean, aromatic, and more tender than the well-done beef version.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | rare beef | onion | herbs and lime
good_to_know: If rare beef makes you nervous, order phở chín instead. The broth should still be hot enough to soften the beef at the table.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở tái.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pho with rare beef.

at_a_glance: Phở chín is beef phở with cooked beef slices, rice noodles, herbs, and clear fragrant broth. It is the safer choice if you want phở without rare meat.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | well-done beef | onion | herbs and lime
good_to_know: Chín means cooked or well-done here. You still season the bowl at the table with herbs, lime, bean sprouts, or chili.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở chín.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pho with well-done beef.

english_translation: Pho with rare beef and brisket
at_a_glance: Phở tái nạm gives you two beef textures in one bowl: tender rare beef and richer brisket. It is still a clean broth dish, but the meat feels fuller than plain phở tái.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | rare beef | brisket | herbs and lime
good_to_know: Nạm is brisket, so this bowl has more chew and beef depth. Taste the broth before adding chili sauce or lime.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở tái nạm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pho with rare beef and brisket.

at_a_glance: Phở bò viên is beef phở with springy beef meatballs, clear broth, rice noodles, herbs, and lime. It is a good choice when you want texture without rare slices.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | beef meatballs | onion | herbs and lime
good_to_know: Bò viên are bouncy beef meatballs. The texture is firmer than sliced beef and easy to recognize in a mixed phở menu.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở bò viên.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pho with beef meatballs.

at_a_glance: Phở đặc biệt is the special combination bowl, usually with several beef cuts such as rare beef, brisket, meatballs, tendon, or tripe depending on the shop.
usually_includes: beef broth | rice noodles | mixed beef cuts | onion | herbs and lime
good_to_know: Đặc biệt means special, not one fixed recipe. Ask what is included if tendon, tripe, or rare beef matters.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở đặc biệt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of special combination pho.

at_a_glance: Bún bò Huế is a bold central-Vietnam noodle soup with lemongrass, chili warmth, beef, and thick round noodles. It is richer and spicier than phở.
usually_includes: broth | rice vermicelli | beef | herbs | lime
good_to_know: Ask for less spicy if you are heat-sensitive. The broth is the point, so taste it before adding extra chili.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún bò Huế.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of spicy Hue beef noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún riêu cua is crab-and-tomato vermicelli soup with a tangy red broth, soft crab mixture, tofu, herbs, and sometimes snails or pork blood cubes. It is bright, savory, and a little rustic.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | crab-tomato broth | tofu | herbs | shrimp paste optional
good_to_know: The sourness usually comes from tomato and tamarind or vinegar-like seasoning, not cream. Ask what toppings are included if you avoid shellfish or pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún riêu cua.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of crab and tomato noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún mắm is a Mekong-style noodle soup with fermented fish broth, rice vermicelli, seafood, pork, eggplant, herbs, and a deep salty aroma. It is bold on purpose.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | fermented fish broth | seafood | pork | eggplant and herbs
good_to_know: This is one of the strongest-flavored soups on a Vietnamese menu. If fermented fish sounds like too much, choose bún riêu or phở first.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún mắm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of fermented fish noodle soup.

english_translation: Hanoi chicken, egg, and pork noodle soup
at_a_glance: Bún thang is a delicate Hanoi noodle soup layered with shredded chicken, egg ribbons, pork sausage, herbs, and clear broth. It is refined rather than fiery.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | clear chicken broth | shredded chicken | egg ribbons | pork sausage
good_to_know: The bowl can include pork sausage, egg, and dried-shrimp flavor. It is not just chicken soup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún thang.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of Hanoi chicken, egg, and pork noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún mọc is pork-and-mushroom ball noodle soup, usually with rice vermicelli, mọc, pork slices, herbs, and clear broth.
usually_includes: clear pork broth | rice vermicelli | mọc pork-mushroom balls | pork slices | fresh herbs
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún mọc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pork meatball noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún cá is fish noodle soup, usually with fried or fresh fish, dill or tomato, herbs, and rice vermicelli.
usually_includes: fish broth | rice vermicelli | fried or fresh fish | tomato or dill | fresh herbs
good_to_know: Fish bones can appear, especially in more traditional bowls.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún cá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of fish noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún ốc is snail vermicelli soup, often Hanoi-style, with a tomato-bright broth, herbs, and chewy river snails. It is tangy, clean, and more about texture than richness.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | snails | tomato broth | herbs | chili optional
good_to_know: Ốc means snails. If texture matters, ask before ordering; the snails should be chewy rather than soft like clams.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún ốc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of snail noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún sứa is a coastal jellyfish noodle soup, especially familiar around Nha Trang and central beach towns. The broth is light; the jellyfish adds a crisp springy bite.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | jellyfish | light seafood broth | herbs | fish cake optional
good_to_know: Sứa means jellyfish. Order it when you are curious about a cool, crisp seafood texture that feels more like a beach-market salad than a heavy noodle bowl.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún sứa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of jellyfish noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Hủ tiếu Nam Vang is a rice-noodle soup with clear savory broth, herbs, and pork and shrimp. It usually feels lighter and more flexible than richer beef soups.
usually_includes: broth | rice noodles | pork and shrimp | herbs | lime
good_to_know: If you want a milder bowl, ask for less spicy or no chili. The soup will still have plenty of flavor.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô hủ tiếu Nam Vang.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of Phnom Penh-style rice noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta rice-noodle soup from the Mỹ Tho style, known for clear broth, chewy noodles, pork, shrimp, herbs, and fried garlic.
usually_includes: rice noodles | pork or shrimp toppings | fried shallots | dry noodle dressing | clear side broth
good_to_know: Mỹ Tho is a Mekong Delta name to recognize. The dry version should still come with broth, because that clear, sweet side bowl is the backbone of the noodles.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of mỹ Tho-style rice noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Mì hoành thánh is wonton egg-noodle soup, usually with pork wontons, egg noodles, chives, and broth.
usually_includes: egg noodles | wontons | clear broth | greens | scallions
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Mì hoành thánh mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì hoành thánh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of wonton egg noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Mì gà is chicken egg-noodle soup, usually with springy mì, chicken, greens, and clear broth.
usually_includes: egg noodles | chicken | chicken broth | greens | scallions
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Mì gà mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of chicken egg noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Miến gà is chicken glass-noodle soup, usually with slippery miến, shredded chicken, herbs, and clear broth.
usually_includes: glass noodles | chicken | chicken broth | scallions | pepper and herbs
good_to_know: Miến means glass noodles, so expect slippery transparent noodles in chicken broth, not wheat or egg noodles.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô miến gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of chicken glass noodle soup.

english_translation: Thick tapioca noodle soup with crab
at_a_glance: Bánh canh cua is thick tapioca-style noodle soup with crab, a glossy savory broth, herbs, and pepper. The noodles are chewy and spoonable, closer to udon texture than phở.
usually_includes: thick tapioca noodles | crab | savory broth | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: The broth can be slightly thick from the noodles. Ask about crab shell pieces if you want the easiest version to eat.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bánh canh cua.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of thick tapioca noodle soup with crab.

english_translation: Thick noodle soup with fish cakes
at_a_glance: Bánh canh chả cá is thick noodle soup with springy fish cakes and a light seafood broth. It is gentler than crab bánh canh but still has the chewy noodle texture.
usually_includes: thick tapioca noodles | fish cakes | seafood broth | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: Chả cá means fish cake here. The fish is usually formed into slices or patties, not a whole fillet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bánh canh chả cá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of thick noodle soup with fish cakes.

english_translation: Thick noodle soup with pork knuckle
at_a_glance: Bánh canh giò heo is thick noodle soup with pork knuckle, scallions, pepper, and a rich pork broth. It is heavier and more collagen-rich than the seafood versions.
usually_includes: thick tapioca noodles | pork knuckle | pork broth | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: Giò heo means pork knuckle. Expect bones and skin; ask for an easier cut if that is not what you want.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bánh canh giò heo.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of thick noodle soup with pork knuckle.

at_a_glance: Cháo gà is chicken rice porridge, usually with shredded chicken, scallions, pepper, herbs, and sometimes fried dough sticks.
usually_includes: rice porridge | shredded chicken | ginger | scallions | black pepper
good_to_know: Cháo gà is gentle food, but not bland when it is good. Stir in pepper, herbs, or ginger gradually so the chicken broth stays soothing.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of chicken rice porridge.

at_a_glance: Cháo lòng is pork offal rice porridge with ginger, herbs, pepper, and soft rice. It is warming and traditional, but more adventurous than chicken porridge.
usually_includes: rice porridge | pork offal | ginger | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: Lòng means offal or organs. If you want the gentle porridge experience without organs, choose cháo gà.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo lòng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pork offal rice porridge.

at_a_glance: Cháo hải sản is seafood rice porridge with soft rice, ginger, scallions, pepper, and whatever seafood the shop uses. It is gentle in texture but not always simple for allergies.
usually_includes: rice porridge | seafood | ginger | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: Hải sản means seafood. Ask what seafood is inside if shellfish matters.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo hải sản.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of seafood rice porridge.

at_a_glance: Bún chả pairs smoky grilled pork with rice vermicelli, herbs, and a warm fish-sauce dipping broth. The charm is sweet-savory pork, cool noodles, and bright herbs in the same bite.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | grilled pork | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip | pickled vegetables
good_to_know: The warm dip here is fish-sauce broth balanced with sweetness, vinegar or lime, garlic, and chili.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún chả.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork with vermicelli.

at_a_glance: Bún thịt nướng is rice vermicelli with lemongrass grilled pork, usually with herbs, pickles, peanuts, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | grilled pork | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip | peanuts
good_to_know: The fish-sauce dressing is meant to season the noodles, not sit untouched on the side.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún thịt nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork vermicelli bowl.

at_a_glance: Bún nem nướng is rice vermicelli with grilled pork sausage, usually with herbs, peanuts, pickles, and a thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | grilled pork sausage | fresh herbs | thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip | crispy crunch
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún nem nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork sausage vermicelli bowl.

at_a_glance: Bún bò Nam Bộ is southern beef noodle salad, usually with warm beef, herbs, peanuts, fried shallots, and sweet-tart fish sauce.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | seared beef | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip | peanuts or fried shallots
good_to_know: The fish-sauce dressing goes over the bowl and gets tossed through the noodles, herbs, beef, peanuts, and fried shallots. Pour gradually if you want more control over sweetness and salt.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún bò Nam Bộ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of southern beef vermicelli salad.

at_a_glance: Bún bò xào is stir-fried beef over cool rice vermicelli with herbs, pickles, peanuts or fried shallots, and fish-sauce dip. It is savory, bright, and built for mixing.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | stir-fried beef | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip | peanuts or fried shallots
good_to_know: Start with half the fish-sauce dressing, mix, then add more if the noodles need it.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún bò xào.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of stir-fried beef over vermicelli.

at_a_glance: Bún gà nướng is rice vermicelli with grilled chicken, usually with herbs, cucumber, pickles, peanuts, and fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | grilled chicken | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip | fried shallots
good_to_know: Ask for the fish-sauce dressing on the side if you want to control the sweet-salty pour over the noodles.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún gà nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled chicken vermicelli bowl.

at_a_glance: Bún chả cá is rice vermicelli with springy fish cakes, herbs, fried shallots, and a light sauce or broth depending on the shop. It should taste seafood-savory, fresh, and gentle.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | fish cakes | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip or light broth | fried shallots
good_to_know: Contains fish; ask about bones if the shop also adds fish pieces.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún chả cá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vermicelli noodles with fish cakes.

english_translation: Vermicelli with tofu and shrimp paste
at_a_glance: Bún đậu mắm tôm is a northern-style platter of rice vermicelli, fried tofu, herbs, and pungent shrimp-paste sauce. It is salty, vivid, and defined by the mắm tôm, a pungent fermented shrimp-paste dip.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | fried tofu | fresh herbs | mắm tôm | pork optional
good_to_know: Mắm tôm is fermented shrimp-paste sauce with a strong aroma. Many places can offer a milder fish-sauce dip if you ask.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún đậu mắm tôm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vermicelli with tofu and shrimp paste.

english_translation: Duck and bamboo shoot vermicelli soup
at_a_glance: Bún măng vịt is duck and bamboo-shoot vermicelli soup, usually served with herbs and a ginger fish-sauce dip for the duck.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | duck | bamboo shoots | herbs | ginger fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Duck often comes with a ginger fish-sauce dip on the side. Use it for the meat, then taste the broth before adding extra chili.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún măng vịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of duck and bamboo shoot vermicelli soup.

at_a_glance: Cao lầu is a Hội An noodle bowl with chewy noodles, pork, herbs, crisp bits, and a small amount of seasoned pork sauce. It is more concentrated and local-specialty than soup-like.
usually_includes: chewy rice noodles | pork | fresh herbs | savory pork sauce | crispy rice crackers
good_to_know: Cao lầu is not a soup bowl and not a dip bowl. The shallow pork coating should cling to the thick Hội An noodles while herbs, bean sprouts, and cracklings keep each bite lively.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cao lầu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Hội An pork noodle dish.

at_a_glance: Mì Quảng gà is a Quảng Nam-style chicken noodle bowl with wide turmeric rice noodles, shallow chicken broth, herbs, peanuts, and a crisp rice cracker. It is a central-Vietnam dish, not a soup.
usually_includes: wide turmeric rice noodles | chicken | turmeric broth | peanuts | rice cracker
good_to_know: The broth is intentionally shallow and concentrated. Mix before adding lime or chili so the turmeric broth coats the noodles.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì Quảng gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of quảng-style turmeric noodles with chicken.

english_translation: Quảng-style turmeric noodles with shrimp and pork
at_a_glance: Mì Quảng tôm thịt is the shrimp-and-pork version of Quảng-style turmeric noodles, with herbs, peanuts, rice cracker, and just enough broth to stain the noodles golden.
usually_includes: wide turmeric rice noodles | shrimp and pork | turmeric broth | peanuts | rice cracker
good_to_know: This commonly includes both shellfish and pork. Ask before ordering if either one matters.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì Quảng tôm thịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of quảng-style turmeric noodles with shrimp and pork.

at_a_glance: Mì xào bò is stir-fried egg noodles with beef, usually with greens, garlic, onion, and glossy sauce.
usually_includes: egg noodles | beef | fresh herbs | garlic-fish-sauce stir-fry glaze | fried shallots or crunchy topping
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Mì xào bò mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì xào bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of stir-fried egg noodles with beef.

at_a_glance: Mì xào hải sản is stir-fried noodles with seafood, usually with shrimp, squid, greens, garlic, and fish-sauce-and-garlic glaze.
usually_includes: egg noodles | seafood | fresh herbs | garlic-fish-sauce stir-fry glaze | fried shallots or crunchy topping
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì xào hải sản.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of stir-fried egg noodles with seafood.

at_a_glance: Mì khô is dry egg noodles, usually with char siu or chicken, greens, sauce, and a side bowl of broth.
usually_includes: egg noodles | savory toppings | fried shallots | greens | side broth
good_to_know: Khô means dry, but a small broth bowl often comes with it; that two-part eating style is normal.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì khô.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of dry egg noodles.

at_a_glance: Hủ tiếu khô is dry hủ tiếu noodles, usually with minced pork, shrimp or slices, herbs, sauce, and broth on the side.
usually_includes: rice noodles | pork or shrimp toppings | fried shallots | savory dry noodle dressing | clear side broth
good_to_know: Khô means dry-style, but the broth still matters. Many southern shops serve it on the side so you get both chewy dressed noodles and a clean pork-seafood broth.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô hủ tiếu khô.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of dry rice noodles.

at_a_glance: Miến xào cua is glass noodles stir-fried with crab, usually with sweet crab meat, egg, onion, herbs, and pepper.
usually_includes: glass noodles | crab | garlic | garlic-fish-sauce stir-fry glaze | herbs
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô miến xào cua.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of stir-fried glass noodles with crab.

at_a_glance: Miến xào hải sản is glass noodles stir-fried with seafood, usually with shrimp, squid, vegetables, and garlic.
usually_includes: glass noodles | seafood | garlic | garlic-fish-sauce stir-fry glaze | herbs
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô miến xào hải sản.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of stir-fried glass noodles with seafood.

english_translation: Fine rice vermicelli sheets with grilled pork
at_a_glance: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng is fine rice-noodle sheets with grilled pork, usually with scallion oil, herbs, rice paper, and fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: fine rice vermicelli sheets | grilled pork | scallion oil | fresh herbs | rice paper and fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh hỏi thịt nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fine rice vermicelli sheets with grilled pork.

english_translation: Fine rice vermicelli sheets with roasted pork
at_a_glance: Bánh hỏi heo quay is fine woven rice noodles with roast pork, usually with crackling heo quay, scallion oil, herbs, and fish sauce.
usually_includes: fine rice vermicelli sheets | roasted pork | scallion oil | fresh herbs | rice paper and fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh hỏi heo quay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fine rice vermicelli sheets with roasted pork.

english_translation: Broken rice with grilled pork chop
at_a_glance: Cơm tấm sườn is a classic southern broken-rice plate with grilled pork chop, scallion oil, pickles, cucumber, and a sweet-savory nước mắm dressing.
usually_includes: broken rice | grilled pork chop | scallion oil | pickles and cucumber | nước mắm dressing
good_to_know: The small bowl is usually sweet-savory nước mắm dressing. Pour it over the rice and pork a little at a time so the grains stay glossy, not flooded.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm tấm sườn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of broken rice with grilled pork chop.

english_translation: Broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, and egg meatloaf
at_a_glance: Cơm tấm bì chả sườn is a loaded broken-rice plate: grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, steamed egg meatloaf, pickles, scallion oil, and fish-sauce dressing.
usually_includes: broken rice | grilled pork chop | shredded pork skin | egg meatloaf | fish-sauce dressing
good_to_know: Bì is shredded pork skin with toasted rice powder; chả is the steamed egg-and-pork loaf.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm tấm bì chả sườn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, and egg meatloaf.

vietnamese_item: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng
english_translation: Broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, meatloaf, and egg
sound_out: kum tahm swoon bee chah choong
at_a_glance: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng is the maximal broken-rice plate: pork chop, shredded pork skin, egg meatloaf, fried egg, pickles, scallion oil, and nước mắm.
usually_includes: broken rice | grilled pork chop | shredded pork skin | egg meatloaf | fried egg
good_to_know: This is one of the most complete cơm tấm orders; it can be a big meal.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, meatloaf, and egg.

at_a_glance: Cơm sườn nướng is rice with a grilled pork chop, pickles, cucumber, scallion oil, and nước mắm. It is the straightforward cousin of cơm tấm.
usually_includes: rice | grilled pork chop | pickles | scallion oil | fish-sauce dressing
good_to_know: Sườn here usually means pork chop or cutlet, not American barbecue ribs.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm sườn nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of rice with grilled pork chop.

at_a_glance: Cơm gà Hội An is Hội An chicken rice: turmeric-tinted rice, shredded or chopped chicken, herbs, onion, chili-lime seasoning, and often a small side broth.
usually_includes: turmeric rice | chicken | herbs | onion | chili-lime seasoning
good_to_know: This is not plain chicken on rice. The rice, herbs, and chili-lime onion mixture are what make it taste like Hội An.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm gà Hội An.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Hội An chicken rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm gà xối mỡ is crispy fried chicken over rice, often with chicken-fat fragrance, pickles, cucumber, and a muối tiêu chanh, a lime-pepper salt dip. It is about crisp skin against hot rice.
usually_includes: rice | crispy fried chicken | pickles | cucumber | muối tiêu chanh, a lime-pepper salt dip
good_to_know: Xối mỡ points to hot fat/oil poured over the chicken for crispness. It is not a sticky-rice dish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm gà xối mỡ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fried chicken rice.

at_a_glance: Vietnam’s take on Hainanese chicken rice: silky poached chicken, fragrant rice, cucumber, herbs, side broth, and ginger-scallion, chili, or soy dips.
usually_includes: fragrant chicken rice | poached chicken | cucumber | side broth | ginger-scallion or chili dip
good_to_know: It is usually mild and a strong option when you want a filling but not spicy meal.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm gà Hải Nam.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Hainanese-style chicken rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm bò lúc lắc is rice with shaking beef, usually with seared beef cubes, tomato, greens, onion, and lime-pepper salt.
usually_includes: rice | shaking beef cubes | onion and bell pepper | lime-pepper salt | pickles or salad
good_to_know: Lime-pepper salt is for the beef cubes, while the rice catches the wok juices. Ask for onion or pepper changes before the beef hits the pan.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm bò lúc lắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of shaking beef with rice.

english_translation: Rice with stir-fried beef and onions
at_a_glance: Cơm bò xào hành tây is rice with beef stir-fried with onions, garlic, and wok seasoning. It is a hot-wok comfort plate, not a stew.
usually_includes: rice | stir-fried beef | onion | garlic | savory garlic-fish-sauce stir-fry glaze
good_to_know: Hành tây means onion. Order this when you want beef-and-rice with a familiar sautéed-onion flavor.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm bò xào hành tây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of rice with stir-fried beef and onions.

english_translation: Rice with braised pork and eggs
at_a_glance: Cơm thịt kho trứng is rice with caramel-braised pork and egg, usually in a salty-sweet fish-sauce braise. The rice is there to soak up the dark sauce.
usually_includes: rice | braised pork | egg | caramel fish-sauce braise | pickles or greens
good_to_know: This is the rice-plate version of a family-style braise. Ask for more rice rather than more sauce if the flavor is too intense.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm thịt kho trứng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of rice with braised pork and eggs.

english_translation: Rice with caramelized fish in clay pot
at_a_glance: Cơm cá kho tộ is rice with clay-pot caramelized fish. The dark fish-sauce caramel is meant to season the rice.
usually_includes: rice | caramelized fish | fish-sauce caramel | black pepper | pickles or greens
good_to_know: Ask about bones if you prefer easier fish pieces. The fish-sauce caramel braise should be intense, not mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm cá kho tộ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of rice with caramelized fish in clay pot.

at_a_glance: Cơm tôm rim is rice with shrimp simmered in a sticky salty-sweet fish-sauce caramel. It is small, punchy, and rice-hungry.
usually_includes: rice | caramelized shrimp | fish-sauce glaze | garlic | pickles or greens
good_to_know: Rim means simmered down until the fish-sauce caramel braise clings. This is not a saucy curry or soup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm tôm rim.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of rice with caramelized shrimp.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên dương châu is Dương Châu fried rice, usually with egg, sausage or ham, shrimp, peas, carrot, and scallion.
usually_includes: fried rice grains | egg | sausage or ham | shrimp | peas and carrots
good_to_know: This mixed fried rice can include shrimp and pork sausage or ham, so ask first if shellfish or pork matters.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên dương châu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of yangzhou fried rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên hải sản is seafood fried rice, usually with shrimp, squid, egg, scallion, and wok-tossed grains.
usually_includes: fried rice | shrimp or squid | egg | scallions | peas or vegetables
good_to_know: Good seafood fried rice should taste wok-hot, lightly smoky, and dotted with sweet seafood. Use chili or soy if offered, but the rice itself should carry the flavor.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên hải sản.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of seafood fried rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên gà is chicken fried rice, usually with egg, chicken, scallion, vegetables, and soy-seasoned rice.
usually_includes: fried rice | chicken | egg | scallions | vegetables
good_to_know: Order this when you want something straightforward and filling. The best versions taste of hot wok, egg, chicken, and scallion rather than a separate condiment.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken fried rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên bò is beef fried rice, usually with wok-tossed rice, egg, beef, scallion, and vegetables.
usually_includes: fried rice | beef | egg | scallions | garlic or onion
good_to_know: The beef and egg should season the rice as it fries. Add chili or soy only if you want extra punch after tasting the first few bites.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef fried rice.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên trứng is egg fried rice, usually with egg, scallion, garlic, and grains fried until separate.
usually_includes: fried rice | egg | scallions | garlic | pepper
good_to_know: This is a simple wok-rice order, often chosen when you want something quick, hot, and not too heavy. The egg should coat the grains lightly.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên trứng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of egg fried rice.

english_translation: Fried rice with beef and pickled mustard greens
at_a_glance: Cơm rang dưa bò is fried rice with beef and pickled mustard greens, usually with egg, garlic, scallions, and a tangy wok flavor.
usually_includes: fried rice | beef | pickled mustard greens | egg | scallions
good_to_know: Dưa chua, pickled mustard greens, gives the rice its northern sour-savory snap; ask for extra dưa if you like that brightness.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm rang dưa bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fried rice with beef and pickled mustard greens.

at_a_glance: Cơm niêu is clay-pot rice, usually with crisp rice edges, fluffy center, and shared savory dishes.
usually_includes: clay-pot rice | crisp rice edges | steamed rice center | shared side dishes | scallion oil optional
good_to_know: Ask what comes with the clay-pot rice. Some places serve a full shared set, while others expect you to choose braised fish, vegetables, or soup separately.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm niêu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of clay pot rice.

english_translation: Clay pot rice with caramelized fish
at_a_glance: Cơm niêu cá kho pairs clay-pot rice with caramelized fish. The fish sauce, caramel, pepper, and rice are the point: salty-sweet sauce against plain rice.
usually_includes: clay-pot rice | caramelized fish | fish-sauce caramel | pepper | pickles or greens
good_to_know: Cơm niêu means clay-pot rice, often prized for hot fluffy rice and crisp edges. Watch for fish bones in cá kho.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm niêu cá kho.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of clay pot rice with caramelized fish.

at_a_glance: Xôi gà is sticky rice with chicken, usually with shredded chicken, fried shallots, herbs, and sometimes chicken sauce.
usually_includes: sticky rice | chicken | fried shallots | savory topping
good_to_know: This is often a morning or takeaway packet. Fried shallots, chicken shreds, and warm sticky rice matter more than a separate dip.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sticky rice with chicken.

english_translation: Sticky rice with mung bean and fried shallots
at_a_glance: Xôi xéo is yellow sticky rice with mung bean, usually with fried shallots, chicken fat or oil, and optional toppings.
usually_includes: sticky rice | mung bean paste | fried shallots | scallion oil | salted seasoning
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Xôi xéo mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi xéo.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sticky rice with mung bean and fried shallots.

at_a_glance: Xôi mặn is savory sticky rice with assorted toppings such as Chinese sausage, shredded pork, egg, fried shallots, and pâté-like spreads depending on the vendor.
usually_includes: sticky rice | Chinese sausage | egg or pâté | pork floss | fried shallots
good_to_know: It is dense for its size. Treat it as a portable breakfast or snack that eats more like a small meal.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi mặn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of savory sticky rice.

at_a_glance: Xôi lạp xưởng is sticky rice with Chinese sausage, usually with sweet-savory lạp xưởng, fried shallots, and sticky grains.
usually_includes: sticky rice | pork | fried shallots | savory topping
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi lạp xưởng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sticky rice with Chinese sausage.

english_translation: Sticky rice dumpling with mung bean and pork
at_a_glance: Xôi khúc is sticky rice dumpling with khúc leaves, usually with mung bean, pork filling, and herbal green rice.
usually_includes: sticky rice | khúc leaf dough | mung bean | pork filling | fried shallots optional
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi khúc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sticky rice dumpling with mung bean and pork.

at_a_glance: Xôi bắp is sticky rice with corn, usually with mung bean, fried shallot, sugar or savory toppings.
usually_includes: sticky rice | corn | mung bean | fried shallots | sugar or coconut optional
good_to_know: Xôi bắp can lean lightly sweet or lightly savory depending on the seller. Look for chewy corn, sticky rice, mung bean, fried shallots, and a sesame-sugar or coconut finish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi bắp.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sticky rice with corn.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì đặc biệt is the house-special sandwich, stacking the French-Vietnamese bánh mì story with pâté, cold cuts, pickles, cucumber, cilantro, chili, and seasoning.
usually_includes: baguette | pâté | Vietnamese cold cuts | pickles and cucumber | cilantro and chili
good_to_know: Fillings vary by shop. Ask what meats are inside if pork, pâté, or processed meat matters, and keep the pickles unless you truly dislike sour crunch.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì đặc biệt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one special bánh mì.

at_a_glance: The classic mixed-meat bánh mì: French-introduced bread made Vietnamese with pâté, pork, đồ chua pickles, cilantro, cucumber, chili, and street-cart speed.
usually_includes: baguette | pork | pickled vegetables | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: If you do not eat pâté or pork liver, ask before ordering.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì thịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bánh mì thịt.

at_a_glance: A smoky grilled-pork bánh mì with sweet-savory marinade, fresh herbs, cucumber, pickles, and chili tucked into a crisp loaf.
usually_includes: baguette | pork | pickled vegetables | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: Ask for less chili if you want to focus on the lemongrass sweetness.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì thịt nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one grilled pork bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì heo quay is roast-pork bánh mì, bringing crackling pork into Vietnam’s French-influenced street sandwich with pickles, cucumber, cilantro, and chili.
usually_includes: baguette | roast pork with crackling | pickles | cucumber | cilantro
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì heo quay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one roast pork bánh mì.

at_a_glance: A cool, savory bánh mì that puts Vietnam’s smooth chả lụa pork sausage into a French-influenced loaf with herbs and pickles.
usually_includes: baguette | pork | pickled vegetables | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: Useful phrase: ask for no chili if you are heat-sensitive.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì chả lụa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one chả lụa bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì ốp la is a breakfast bánh mì with sunny eggs, herbs, cucumber, pickles, chili, and Maggi-style soy seasoning, often cooked on a small street griddle.
usually_includes: baguette | egg | pickled vegetables | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want the egg sandwich without chili.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì ốp la.
quick_say_english: I’d like one fried egg bánh mì.

at_a_glance: A chicken bánh mì with shredded or grilled gà, crisp pickles, herbs, and bright chili, pâté, or Maggi-style seasoning inside Vietnam's famous airy baguette.
usually_includes: baguette | chicken | pickled vegetables | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: Ask whether it has pâté if you avoid pork liver.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one chicken bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì bò kho is Vietnamese beef stew served with crisp baguette for dipping. The stew is warm, aromatic, and rich with beef, carrots, and gentle spice.
usually_includes: baguette | beef stew | carrots | herbs | spiced broth
good_to_know: This is not a filled sandwich. Tear the bread and dip it into the broth, then use herbs, lime, or chili to brighten the stew.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò kho bánh mì.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef stew with bread.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì pate carries the bánh mì story in one loaf: French-style pâté and bread reshaped by Vietnam’s herbs, pickles, chili, and street-food pace.
usually_includes: baguette | pâté | pickles | cilantro | chili optional
good_to_know: Pâté is usually liver-based. If that flavor is not for you, choose grilled pork, chicken, or egg, but try to notice how the pickles and herbs are designed to balance the richness.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì pate.
quick_say_english: I’d like one pâté bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì xíu mại is a meatball bánh mì, often saucier than the cold-cut versions. The pork meatballs and tomato-like sauce make the bread softer and more comforting.
usually_includes: baguette | pork meatballs | tomato-rich xíu mại sauce | pickles | cilantro
good_to_know: This one can be messy in a good way. Eat it sitting down if the bread is filled with tomato-pork xíu mại sauce rather than dry toppings.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì xíu mại.
quick_say_english: I’d like one xíu mại bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh mì chay is vegetarian bánh mì, usually with tofu, mushrooms, mock meat, pickles, cucumber, cilantro, chili, and vegetarian seasoning.
usually_includes: baguette | tofu or mock meat | mushrooms optional | pickles and cucumber | cilantro
good_to_know: Chay means vegetarian, but strict vegetarians should still ask about fish sauce, egg, and dairy because Maggi-style soy seasoning, chili, or pâté spreads vary.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ổ bánh mì chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one vegetarian bánh mì.

at_a_glance: Bánh bao is a soft steamed bun with a sealed savory filling inside slightly sweet dough. It is warm, portable, and closer to a filled bun than a sandwich.
usually_includes: steamed bun | savory filling | soft dough | egg optional | pork optional
good_to_know: Do not ask for this toasted like bánh mì. The point is the soft steamed dough and hidden filling.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh bao.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of steamed bun.

at_a_glance: Bánh bao xá xíu is a steamed bun filled with sweet-savory barbecue pork. The soft dough and saucy pork are the appeal.
usually_includes: steamed bun | xá xíu pork | sweet-salty glaze | soft dough
good_to_know: Xá xíu means char siu-style pork. This is a pork bun, not a crisp baguette sandwich.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh bao xá xíu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one char siu steamed bun.

at_a_glance: Bánh bao chay is a vegetarian steamed bun, usually filled with mushrooms, vegetables, tofu, or mock meat depending on the shop.
usually_includes: steamed bun | vegetarian filling | mushrooms or vegetables | soft dough
good_to_know: Chay signals vegetarian, but ask about egg or dairy if strict. The bun should be steamed, soft, and warm.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh bao chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian steamed bun.

at_a_glance: Bánh tiêu is a hollow sesame donut with a crisp outside, airy middle, and gentle sweetness. It is a street snack, not a sandwich.
usually_includes: fried sesame dough | hollow center | light sweetness
good_to_know: Freshness matters most. The outside should still have a little crackle, while the center stays light and hollow.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh tiêu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of hollow sesame donut.

at_a_glance: Bánh patê sô is a savory puff pastry with flaky layers and seasoned filling. It belongs to Vietnam’s bakery-counter snack lane.
usually_includes: puff pastry | savory filling | buttery layers
good_to_know: It is best warm, when the pastry is flaky and the filling is aromatic. Treat it as a quick bakery snack, not a bánh mì.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh patê sô.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of savory puff pastry.

at_a_glance: Gỏi cuốn are fresh spring rolls wrapped in rice paper with herbs, noodles, and a light filling. They are cool, clean, and great as a starter or snack.
usually_includes: rice paper | fresh spring rolls | rice vermicelli | herbs | peanut sauce or fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Peanut-hoisin dip and fish-sauce-lime dip change the flavor. Peanut sauce is richer; fish-sauce dip is lighter, salty, sweet, and bright.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi cuốn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fresh spring rolls.

english_translation: Fresh spring rolls with shrimp and pork
at_a_glance: Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt is fresh rolls with shrimp and pork, usually with rice paper, herbs, noodles, lettuce, and peanut or fish sauce.
usually_includes: rice paper | shrimp and pork | rice vermicelli | herbs | peanut sauce or fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi cuốn tôm thịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fresh spring rolls with shrimp and pork.

at_a_glance: Nem cuốn is fresh nem rolls, usually with rice paper, herbs, noodles, pork or shrimp depending on the shop, and peanut-hoisin dip or fish-sauce-lime dip.
usually_includes: rice paper | fresh rolls, northern style | rice vermicelli | herbs | peanut sauce or fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: If peanut-hoisin dip or fish-sauce-lime dip comes separately, start with a small dip; it can be salty, sweet, sour, and spicy at once.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nem cuốn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fresh rolls, northern style.

at_a_glance: Nem nướng cuốn is fresh rolls with grilled pork sausage, usually with nem nướng, herbs, pickles, rice paper, and a thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip.
usually_includes: rice paper | pork | rice vermicelli | herbs | thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nem nướng cuốn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork sausage rolls.

at_a_glance: Chả giò is Vietnamese fried spring rolls, usually with crisp shell, pork or mixed filling, lettuce, herbs, and fish sauce.
usually_includes: fried wrapper | fried spring rolls | vegetables | herbs | fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: If sweet-sour fish-sauce dip comes separately, start with a small dip; it can be salty, sweet, sour, and spicy at once.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả giò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fried spring rolls.

english_translation: Fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork
at_a_glance: Chả giò tôm thịt is fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork, usually with rice paper or wheat wrapper, herbs, lettuce, and fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: fried wrapper | shrimp and pork filling | lettuce | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả giò tôm thịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork.

at_a_glance: Nem rán is northern fried spring rolls, usually with pork, glass noodles, wood ear, crisp wrapper, lettuce, and sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: fried wrapper | northern fried spring rolls | vegetables | herbs | fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Northern-style fried rolls often include pork, mushroom, and glass noodles; dip lightly so the crisp wrapper stays crisp.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nem rán.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of northern fried spring rolls.

at_a_glance: Bì cuốn is fresh rolls with shredded pork skin, usually with rice paper, herbs, noodles, thính, and sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: rice paper | shredded pork skin | toasted rice powder | herbs | fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bì cuốn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of shredded pork skin rolls.

at_a_glance: Bò bía is thin fresh rolls with jicama and sausage, usually with egg, herbs, dried shrimp, and peanut-hoisin sauce.
usually_includes: rice paper | jicama | sausage or egg | herbs | hoisin-peanut sauce
good_to_know: If peanut-hoisin dip or fish-sauce-lime dip comes separately, start with a small dip; it can be salty, sweet, sour, and spicy at once.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò bía.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of jicama and sausage rolls.

at_a_glance: Chạo tôm is grilled shrimp paste on sugarcane, usually served with herbs, rice paper, noodles, and fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: shrimp paste | sugarcane | rice paper | fresh herbs | fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chạo tôm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sugarcane shrimp.

at_a_glance: Bò lá lốt is beef wrapped in betel leaves, usually with grilled aroma, herbs, rice paper, and sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: beef in betel leaves | herbs | rice paper optional | sweet-sour fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Rice paper may be served depending on the shop; if you want to wrap, ask for rice paper.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò lá lốt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef wrapped in betel leaves.

at_a_glance: Bánh xèo is a crisp turmeric-rice pancake eaten by tearing pieces into rice paper or lettuce with herbs, then dipping in the fish-sauce dip.

at_a_glance: Crisp-fried fish with a golden crust, usually eaten with rice, herbs, and a lime-pepper salt dip or ginger fish sauce that cuts through the crunch.

good_to_know: This is family-meal food, not a creamy coconut curry. Coconut water adds gentle sweetness and depth; spoon the braising liquid over rice.

quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần thịt luộc cuốn bánh tráng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of boiled pork with rice paper rolls.

usually_includes: grilled pork sausage | rice paper optional | fresh herbs | rice noodles | thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nem nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork sausage.

at_a_glance: Chả lụa is Vietnamese steamed pork sausage, usually with smooth slices, pepper, banana-leaf aroma, and rice or bánh mì.
usually_includes: smooth steamed pork sausage | banana-leaf aroma | white pepper | slices for bánh mì or rice | chả texture
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả lụa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese pork sausage.

at_a_glance: Chả quế is cinnamon pork sausage, usually with warm spice, smooth pork paste, and a lightly browned outside.
usually_includes: pork sausage | cinnamon aroma | fried or browned outside | pepper | slices for rice or bánh mì
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả quế.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of cinnamon pork sausage.

at_a_glance: Giò thủ is head cheese-style pork terrine, usually with ear, cheek, pepper, wood ear mushroom, and banana-leaf wrapping.
usually_includes: pork terrine | ear or cheek pieces | wood ear mushroom | black pepper | banana-leaf wrapping
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần giò thủ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of pork head terrine.

at_a_glance: Bì is shredded pork skin, usually with toasted rice powder, lean pork, herbs, and rice plates or rolls.
usually_includes: shredded pork skin | toasted rice powder | pork | rice plate or rolls | herbs
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bì.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of shredded pork skin.

english_translation: Pork belly fried with fish sauce
at_a_glance: Ba rọi chiên nước mắm is pork belly fried until crisp, then tossed in garlic fish-sauce glaze. It is salty, sticky, crunchy, and built for sharing with rice.
usually_includes: pork belly | fish sauce glaze | garlic | scallions | crispy edges
good_to_know: Nước mắm is fish sauce, but here it becomes a glaze with sugar and garlic. It is not a lime-pepper salt dip or ginger fish sauce on the side.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần ba rọi chiên nước mắm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of pork belly fried with fish sauce.

at_a_glance: Ba rọi nướng is grilled pork belly, usually with charred fat, lemongrass or honeyed marinade, herbs, and rice or noodles.
usually_includes: pork belly | charred fat | savory marinade | herbs | rice paper or rice
good_to_know: The pork belly is rich, so rice paper, herbs, cucumber, or a light dip help balance the charred fat. Ask for the dip on the side if you want control.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần ba rọi nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled pork belly.

at_a_glance: Giò heo hầm is braised or simmered pork leg, usually with gelatinous skin, tender meat, broth, and vegetables.
usually_includes: pork knuckle | clear broth | root vegetables or greens | scallions | black pepper
good_to_know: Hầm means simmered. Expect gelatin-rich pork knuckle in broth, so the pleasure is tender skin, soft meat, and a warming bowl rather than a caramelized kho plate.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần giò heo hầm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of braised pork knuckle.

at_a_glance: Cháo sườn is pork rib rice porridge, usually with soft rice, tender rib meat, scallion, pepper, and fried dough if offered.
usually_includes: rice porridge | pork ribs | black pepper | scallions | quẩy fried dough if offered
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo sườn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pork rib porridge.

at_a_glance: Lạp xưởng is sweet-savory Chinese-style sausage, usually with sticky rice or rice, rendered fat, and a glossy bite.
usually_includes: sweet Chinese-style sausage | pork fat | rice or sticky rice | soy-salty sweetness | sliced pieces
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần lạp xưởng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chinese-style sausage.

at_a_glance: Xá xíu is Vietnamese char siu pork, usually with red-edged roast pork, sweet glaze, rice or noodles.
usually_includes: char siu pork | sweet-savory glaze | rice or egg noodles | bánh mì filling | scallions
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xá xíu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese-style barbecue pork.

at_a_glance: Gà nướng muối ớt is salt-chili grilled chicken, usually with smoky skin, chili salt rub, herbs, and cucumber.
usually_includes: chicken | chili-salt rub | grilled skin | cucumber or herbs | lime-pepper salt optional
good_to_know: This can be spicy even without adding dip, because the chili salt cooks onto the chicken.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà nướng muối ớt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled chicken with chili salt.

at_a_glance: Gà rô ti is Vietnamese rô ti chicken, usually with soy or fish-sauce glaze, gentle sweetness, and rice.
usually_includes: chicken | rô ti glaze | rice | pickles or cucumber | pan juices
good_to_know: Rô ti is usually sweet-savory and glossy, often with garlic and soy or fish-sauce depth; ask for rice to catch the pan juices.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà rô ti.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese roasted chicken.

at_a_glance: Gà chiên nước mắm is fish-sauce fried chicken, usually with crisp skin, garlic, sugar, and salty glaze.
usually_includes: chicken | crispy coating | fish sauce glaze | garlic | herbs
good_to_know: The glaze is fish sauce, sugar, garlic, and chili, so it is sticky, savory, and sweet rather than a plain fried-chicken sauce.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà chiên nước mắm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fish sauce fried chicken.

english_translation: Chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili
at_a_glance: Gà xào sả ớt is chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, usually with sả, onion, rice, and a fish-sauce-and-garlic glaze.
usually_includes: chicken | lemongrass | chili | garlic | rice on the side
good_to_know: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà xào sả ớt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken stir-fried with lemongrass and chili.

at_a_glance: Gà kho gừng is chicken braised with ginger, usually with fish sauce, caramel color, pepper, and rice.
usually_includes: chicken | ginger | fish-sauce caramel | black pepper | rice on the side
good_to_know: The heat comes from ginger and pepper as much as chili, so it can feel warming even when it is not fiery.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà kho gừng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken braised with ginger.

at_a_glance: Gà hấp hành is steamed chicken with scallion, usually with ginger, salt, chicken juices, and herbs.
usually_includes: chicken | scallions | ginger | rau răm or herbs | salt-lime dip
good_to_know: Hấp hành means steamed with scallions. The flavor should be gentle and chicken-forward, with ginger, scallion, or a light salt-lime note if served.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà hấp hành.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of steamed chicken with scallions.

at_a_glance: Gà luộc is poached chicken, usually with lime-pepper salt, herbs, and sometimes sticky rice or porridge.
usually_includes: poached chicken | rau răm | lime-pepper salt | ginger fish sauce optional | rice or porridge side
good_to_know: Boiled chicken is often about clean chicken flavor, firm texture, and lime-pepper salt. Dip lightly so the salt and citrus lift the meat without covering it.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà luộc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of boiled chicken.

at_a_glance: Gà nướng lá chanh is grilled chicken with lime leaf, usually with charred skin, citrusy lá chanh, and dipping salt.
usually_includes: grilled chicken | lime leaves | chili-salt marinade | dipping salt | herbs or cucumber
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Gà nướng lá chanh mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà nướng lá chanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled chicken with lime leaves.

at_a_glance: Cánh gà chiên nước mắm is fish-sauce fried chicken wings, usually with garlic, sugar, fish sauce glaze, and lime or chili.
usually_includes: chicken wings | fish-sauce garlic glaze | fried edges | lime or chili optional | herbs or cucumber
good_to_know: Nước mắm is the glaze here, not a side dip; it should cling to the hot wings with garlic and sugar.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cánh gà chiên nước mắm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fish sauce fried chicken wings.

at_a_glance: Cánh gà nướng is grilled chicken wings, usually with charred skin, lemongrass or honeyed marinade, and dipping salt.
usually_includes: grilled chicken wings | savory marinade | charred edges | dipping salt | cucumber or herbs
good_to_know: The wings may be sweet, salty, or spicy depending on the marinade; ask less spicy before they go on the grill.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cánh gà nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled chicken wings.

english_translation: Chicken feet with lemongrass and kumquat
at_a_glance: Chân gà sả tắc is chicken feet tossed with lemongrass and kumquat, usually with crunchy skin, citrus, chili, and fish sauce.
usually_includes: chicken feet | lemongrass | kumquat | chili | fish-sauce dressing
good_to_know: This is a chewy snack, not meaty chicken. The sả tắc dressing should taste sweet-sour, citrusy, salty, and a little spicy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chân gà sả tắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken feet with lemongrass and kumquat.

at_a_glance: Gỏi gà xé phay is shredded chicken salad, usually with cabbage, rau răm, onion, peanuts, and tart fish-sauce dressing.
usually_includes: shredded chicken | cabbage | rau răm | onion | peanuts and bright dressing
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Gỏi gà xé phay mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi gà xé phay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of shredded chicken salad.

at_a_glance: Vịt quay is roast duck with lacquered skin, rich meat, five-spice aroma, and pickles or a dark savory dip depending on the shop.
usually_includes: roast duck | lacquered skin | five-spice aroma | pickles | rice or noodles
good_to_know: Use pickles, herbs, rice, noodles, or a dark savory dip to cut the duck richness. Ask for extra pickles before the duck is chopped.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần vịt quay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of roasted duck.

english_translation: Duck grilled with fermented bean curd
at_a_glance: Vịt nướng chao is duck grilled with fermented tofu sauce, usually with smoky duck, chao, herbs, and pickles.
usually_includes: duck | fermented tofu marinade | grilled char | herbs | pickles
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Vịt nướng chao mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần vịt nướng chao.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of duck grilled with fermented bean curd.

at_a_glance: Vịt om sấu is northern duck simmered with tart sấu fruit, giving the broth a sour lift that cuts through the richness of duck.
usually_includes: duck | sấu fruit | taro or vegetables | herbs | vermicelli optional
good_to_know: Sấu is a tart northern fruit often translated awkwardly as dracontomelon. Think sour, fruity brightness rather than lemon.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần vịt om sấu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of duck stewed with dracontomelon fruit.

at_a_glance: Cháo vịt is duck rice porridge, usually with ginger, scallion, shredded duck, and sometimes cabbage salad.
usually_includes: rice porridge | duck | ginger fish sauce | scallions | black pepper
good_to_know: Duck porridge is richer than chicken porridge. Ginger fish sauce wakes up the duck, so add it gradually if you want the bowl to stay mellow.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô cháo vịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of duck rice porridge.

at_a_glance: Gỏi vịt is duck salad, usually with cabbage, herbs, ginger fish sauce, peanuts, and sliced duck.
usually_includes: duck | cabbage or banana blossom | rau răm | ginger fish-sauce dressing | peanuts optional
good_to_know: Rau răm gives the salad its peppery herbal lift; it is part of the duck flavor, not decoration.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi vịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of duck salad.

at_a_glance: Cà ri gà is Vietnamese chicken curry, usually with coconut milk, potato, carrot, lemongrass, and bread or noodles.
usually_includes: chicken | coconut curry broth | potatoes | carrots | bread or noodles
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Cà ri gà mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cà ri gà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken curry.

at_a_glance: Gà hầm thuốc bắc is chicken simmered with Chinese medicinal herbs, usually with black chicken or tender pieces, dates, goji berries, and dark broth.
usually_includes: chicken | herbal broth | ginger | aromatics | mushrooms
good_to_know: The dark herbal broth is the point; expect medicinal warmth and black chicken or bone-in pieces rather than a light chicken soup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà hầm thuốc bắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken stewed with Chinese herbs.

at_a_glance: Gà ta nướng is free-range chicken grilled over heat, usually with firm meat, crisp skin, lime leaves, and dipping salt.
usually_includes: free-range chicken | grilled skin | lime leaves | dipping salt | herbs or cucumber
good_to_know: Gà ta can be firmer and more flavorful than standard chicken; ask if it is chopped bone-in before ordering.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà ta nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled free-range chicken.

at_a_glance: Tender cubes of “shaking beef” seared in a hot wok, usually served with greens, tomato, onion, and a lime-pepper dipping salt.
usually_includes: seared beef cubes | onion or bell pepper | tomato or salad | lime-pepper salt | rice or fries optional
good_to_know: The classic finishing move is dipping each beef cube into lime-pepper salt. It sharpens the buttery beef without turning the plate into a saucy stir-fry.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò lúc lắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of shaking beef.

at_a_glance: Bò né is a sizzling hot-plate beef breakfast or brunch order, often with egg, pâté, onions, tomato, and a baguette for swiping through the pan juices.
usually_includes: sizzling beef | fried egg | pâté if included | baguette | onion or tomato
good_to_know: Né means to dodge, a playful nod to the spattering hot plate. Keep your face back when it lands, then use the bread to catch egg yolk, beef juices, and pâté.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò né.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sizzling beef steak with eggs.

at_a_glance: Vietnamese beef stew with warm spices, carrot, lemongrass, and tender beef, eaten with bread, noodles, or rice depending on the shop.
usually_includes: beef | spiced broth | carrots | herbs | bread or noodles
good_to_know: Ask whether the shop serves it with bánh mì, hủ tiếu, or mì if you have a preference.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò kho.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese beef stew.

at_a_glance: Bò sốt vang is northern-style beef in red wine sauce, usually with carrot, herbs, tomato-rich gravy, and bread or noodles.
usually_includes: beef | spiced broth | carrots | herbs | bread or noodles
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Bò sốt vang mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò sốt vang.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese red wine beef stew.

at_a_glance: Bò xào lúc lắc is wok-tossed shaking beef pieces, usually with onion, bell pepper, rice, and lime-pepper salt.
usually_includes: seared beef cubes | onion | bell pepper | lime-pepper salt | rice or salad
good_to_know: The wok glaze should cling to the beef cubes and vegetables. Use lime-pepper salt as the bright accent, not as a separate heavy dip.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò xào lúc lắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of stir-fried cubed beef.

at_a_glance: Bò xào rau cải is beef quickly stir-fried with leafy greens, usually with garlic, oyster-style sauce, rice, and crisp-tender vegetables.
usually_includes: beef | rau cải leafy greens | garlic | savory wok seasoning | rice
good_to_know: Ask for no chili if you want Bò xào rau cải mild.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò xào rau cải.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef stir-fried with greens.

english_translation: Beef stir-fried with lemongrass and chili
at_a_glance: Bò xào sả ớt is beef stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, usually with rice, onion, herbs, and fragrant sả.
usually_includes: beef | lemongrass | chili | garlic | rice
good_to_know: Ask for less spicy if heat is a concern.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò xào sả ớt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef stir-fried with lemongrass and chili.

at_a_glance: Bò cuốn lá lốt is seasoned beef wrapped in lá lốt leaves and grilled until smoky. It is often eaten with herbs, rice paper, noodles, and sweet-sour fish-sauce dip.
usually_includes: seasoned beef | lá lốt leaves | herbs | rice paper optional | sweet-sour fish-sauce dip
good_to_know: Lá lốt is piper lolot, often called wild betel leaf in English. It gives the beef a peppery herbal aroma.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò cuốn lá lốt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef wrapped in betel leaves.

at_a_glance: Bò tái chanh is rare beef cured with lime, tossed with herbs, onion, peanuts, and bright dressing. It is a shared appetizer, not a cooked steak plate.
usually_includes: rare beef | lime | herbs | onion | peanuts
good_to_know: Tái means rare. The lime changes the beef texture, but cautious travelers should treat it as rare beef.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò tái chanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef carpaccio with lime.

english_translation: Beef salad with herbs and vinegar
at_a_glance: Gỏi bò bóp thấu is beef salad tossed with herbs and tart dressing, usually with green banana, star fruit, onion, peanuts, and fish sauce.
usually_includes: beef | star fruit or green banana | onion | peanuts | fish-sauce lime dressing
good_to_know: This salad may include peanuts, fish sauce, herbs, and rare or lightly cooked beef, so ask before ordering if any of those matter.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi bò bóp thấu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef salad with herbs and vinegar.

english_translation: Beef dipped in vinegar hot pot
at_a_glance: Bò nhúng dấm is thin beef slices swished through hot vinegar broth, usually with onion, herbs, rice paper, and a small sharp dip of fish sauce, chili, or lime-pepper salt.
usually_includes: thin beef slices | vinegar hot pot broth | rice paper | fresh herbs | noodles and fish-sauce-lime dip
good_to_know: Swish the beef briefly so it stays tender, then roll it with herbs and noodles. This is a table-size meal, so order for the group rather than one quick bowl.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò nhúng dấm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef dipped in vinegar hot pot.

english_translation: Grilled beef wrapped in caul fat
at_a_glance: Bò nướng mỡ chài is seasoned beef wrapped in lacey caul fat and grilled, usually with smoke, herbs, pickles, and a salty-sweet dip.
usually_includes: seasoned beef | caul fat | grilled smoke | rice paper and herbs | salty-sweet dip
good_to_know: Mỡ chài is caul fat wrapped around beef, so the grill flavor is richer than ordinary beef skewers.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò nướng mỡ chài.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled beef wrapped in caul fat.

at_a_glance: Bò kho bánh mì is Vietnamese beef stew served with bread for dipping. The broth is warm with spice, carrots, herbs, and tender beef.
usually_includes: beef stew | baguette | carrots | herbs | spiced broth
good_to_know: This is stew with bread, not a sandwich. Tear the baguette and use it to catch the spiced broth and tender beef pieces.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bò kho bánh mì.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef stew with bread.

at_a_glance: Dê nướng is grilled goat with smoky edges, usually with satay, herbs, cucumber, and rice paper or muối tiêu chanh, a lime-pepper salt dip.
usually_includes: grilled goat | fresh herbs | cucumber | rice paper optional | lime-pepper salt or fermented dip
good_to_know: Grilled goat is usually a shared plate. Herbs, rice paper, cucumber, and dipping salt or fermented dip keep the smoky meat bright.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần dê nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled goat.

at_a_glance: Dê hấp tía tô is goat steamed with purple perilla, ginger, and herbs, usually eaten with dipping salt or a light fermented-bean style dip depending on the shop.
usually_includes: goat | purple perilla | ginger | herbs | dipping salt or light dip
good_to_know: Tía tô gives the goat a herbal, minty-perilla lift. Ask for the dip on the side if you want to taste the steamed goat and herbs first.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần dê hấp tía tô.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of goat steamed with perilla.

at_a_glance: Cà ri dê is goat curry with a rich spiced broth, often eaten with bread or noodles so you can soak up the curry and tender goat pieces.
usually_includes: goat | curry broth | potato or taro | coconut milk or richness | bread or noodles
good_to_know: This is a curry bowl, not a quick dip. Tear bread into the broth or alternate spoonfuls with noodles so the goat, spice, and coconut richness stay together.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cà ri dê.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of goat curry.

english_translation: Goat stir-fried with curry and coconut
at_a_glance: Dê xào lăn is goat stir-fried with curry-like aromatics, usually with coconut milk or spices, herbs, and rice crackers in some versions.
usually_includes: goat | curry and lemongrass aroma | coconut richness | peanuts or sesame | herbs
good_to_know: Xào lăn often means a fragrant curry-leaning stir-fry with coconut richness. It should taste nutty, herbal, and aromatic rather than like a plain garlic stir-fry.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần dê xào lăn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of goat stir-fried with curry and coconut.

at_a_glance: Bê thui is tender young veal, often linked with Quảng Nam/Cầu Mống style, served with herbs, rice paper, and pungent mắm nêm fermented anchovy dip.
usually_includes: veal | rice paper | fresh herbs | green banana or star fruit | mắm nêm
good_to_know: Mắm nêm is fermented anchovy dip, not tamarind. It can be funky, salty, and intense.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bê thui.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of roasted young veal.

english_translation: Roasted veal with rice paper rolls
at_a_glance: Bê thui cuốn bánh tráng is rare veal wrapped at the table, usually with rice paper, herbs, green banana, star fruit, and fermented mắm nêm, a funky fermented anchovy dip.
usually_includes: veal | rice paper | fresh herbs | green banana or star fruit | mắm nêm
good_to_know: Build the roll before judging the veal: herbs, green banana or star fruit, rice paper, and a careful touch of mắm nêm are what make the bite complete.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bê thui cuốn bánh tráng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of roasted veal with rice paper rolls.

at_a_glance: Lẩu dê is goat hot pot for the table, usually with herbs, tofu skin, noodles, taro, and a deep goat broth.
usually_includes: goat hot-pot broth | goat pieces | taro | tofu or tofu skin | greens and noodles
good_to_know: Cook goat, taro, tofu, and greens in stages, then add noodles near the end. Ask how many people the pot serves before ordering.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần lẩu dê.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of goat hot pot.

at_a_glance: Vegetarian phở with rice noodles, herbs, and a lighter broth built from vegetables, mushrooms, and warm spices instead of beef bones.
usually_includes: flat rice noodles | vegetable-mushroom broth | tofu or mushrooms | herbs | lime and chili
good_to_know: Ask whether the broth is vegetable-based and whether fish sauce is used in seasoning if you need it fully vegetarian.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian pho.

at_a_glance: Bún bò Huế chay is vegetarian Huế-style spicy noodle soup, usually with lemongrass broth, thick noodles, tofu, mushrooms, and herbs.
usually_includes: thick rice vermicelli | lemongrass vegetarian broth | tofu or mushrooms | chili oil | herbs
good_to_know: Ask whether the broth is fully vegetarian and whether chili oil or seasoning is made separately from the meat version.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún bò Huế chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian Hue-style noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Bún riêu chay is vegetarian crab-style tomato noodle soup, usually with tomato broth, tofu, mushrooms, herbs, and rice vermicelli.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | tomato broth | tofu | mushrooms | fresh herbs
good_to_know: Chay should mean vegetarian, but mixed shops may still use fish sauce or shared broth unless you ask.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún riêu chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian tomato noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Hủ tiếu chay is vegetarian hủ tiếu noodle soup, usually with clear broth, rice noodles, tofu, mushrooms, greens, and herbs.
usually_includes: rice noodles | light vegetarian broth | tofu | mushrooms | greens and herbs
good_to_know: Ask whether the broth is vegetable-based; hủ tiếu shops may keep pork or seafood broth for standard bowls.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô hủ tiếu chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian rice noodle soup.

at_a_glance: Cơm chay is vegetarian rice plate, usually with rice, tofu, mock meats or vegetables, pickles, and soup.
usually_includes: rice | tofu or mock meat | vegetables | pickles | soup optional
good_to_know: Mixed restaurants may use shared seasonings, so ask if you need strict vegetarian or vegan boundaries.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian rice plate.

at_a_glance: Cơm chiên chay is vegetarian fried rice, usually with egg or tofu depending on the shop, vegetables, scallion, and wok heat.
usually_includes: fried rice | vegetables | tofu or mushrooms | scallions | egg optional
good_to_know: Chay fried rice may still include egg unless you ask; also confirm no fish sauce in mixed kitchens.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cơm chiên chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian fried rice.

at_a_glance: Mì xào chay is vegetarian stir-fried noodles, usually with egg noodles or wheat noodles, vegetables, tofu, garlic, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
usually_includes: noodles | vegetables | tofu or mushrooms | garlic | egg noodles optional
good_to_know: Some vegetarian noodle orders still use egg noodles or egg; ask if you need it vegan.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô mì xào chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian stir-fried noodles.

at_a_glance: Gỏi cuốn chay is vegetarian fresh rolls, usually with rice paper, noodles, tofu, herbs, lettuce, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
usually_includes: rice paper | tofu or mushrooms | rice vermicelli | fresh herbs | vegetarian dip
good_to_know: Ask about the dip: peanut sauce is common, but some shops serve fish-sauce dip unless you specify chay.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gỏi cuốn chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian fresh spring rolls.

at_a_glance: Chả giò chay is vegetarian fried spring rolls, usually with taro, mushrooms, glass noodles, herbs, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
usually_includes: taro | mushrooms | glass noodles | crisp wrapper | herbs and vegetarian dip
good_to_know: Ask what dip comes with it; vegetarian rolls at mixed shops may still be served with a fish-sauce dip.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả giò chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian fried spring rolls.

at_a_glance: Bánh xèo chay is a vegetarian turmeric-rice pancake eaten by tearing pieces into rice paper or lettuce with herbs, then dipping in a vegetarian soy-lime dip.
usually_includes: turmeric rice batter | mushroom filling or tofu | bean sprouts | rice paper or lettuce | herbs and vegetarian dip
good_to_know: Ask whether the dip is vegetarian; some mixed stalls use fish sauce even when the pancake filling is meat-free.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh xèo chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian crispy pancake.

at_a_glance: Đậu hũ kho nấm is tofu and mushrooms braised in a peppery soy-caramel glaze, served with rice for a quiet chay comfort dish.
usually_includes: tofu | mushrooms | soy-caramel glaze | black pepper | rice
good_to_know: Ask whether the braise is fully vegetarian if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần đậu hũ kho nấm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of tofu braised with mushrooms.

english_translation: Tofu fried with lemongrass and chili
at_a_glance: Đậu hũ chiên sả ớt is fried tofu with lemongrass and chili, usually with crisp tofu, sả, chili, garlic, and rice.
usually_includes: fried tofu | lemongrass | chili | garlic | rice on the side
good_to_know: Ask about fish sauce if the tofu is cooked at a mixed rice stall; lemongrass and chili are vegetarian, but seasoning varies.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần đậu hũ chiên sả ớt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of tofu fried with lemongrass and chili.

at_a_glance: Đậu hũ sốt cà chua is tofu in tomato sauce, usually with fried tofu, tomato gravy, scallion, and rice.
usually_includes: fried tofu | tomato gravy | scallions | garlic | rice
good_to_know: Ask whether the tomato sauce uses fish sauce or meat stock at mixed family-style restaurants.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần đậu hũ sốt cà chua.
