quick_say_english: I’d like one order of tofu in tomato sauce.

at_a_glance: Đậu hũ chiên giòn is crispy fried tofu, usually with hot tofu cubes, herbs, and soy or chili sauce.
usually_includes: crispy fried tofu | soft tofu center | soy-chili dip | herbs | rice optional
good_to_know: Ask what dip comes with the tofu; fish sauce can appear at non-vegetarian rice shops.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần đậu hũ chiên giòn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of crispy fried tofu.

at_a_glance: Nấm kho tiêu is mushrooms braised with black pepper and soy-caramel depth, a compact vegetarian dish made for rice.
usually_includes: mushrooms | black pepper | soy-caramel glaze | herbs | rice
good_to_know: Ask whether the braise is fully vegetarian if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nấm kho tiêu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of mushrooms braised with pepper.

at_a_glance: Rau củ xào is stir-fried mixed vegetables, usually with garlic, greens, carrots or seasonal vegetables, and rice.
usually_includes: mixed seasonal vegetables | leafy greens | garlic | savory wok seasoning | rice
good_to_know: Ask whether the vegetables are stir-fried with fish sauce, oyster sauce, or shared wok seasoning at mixed restaurants.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần rau củ xào.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of stir-fried vegetables.

at_a_glance: Canh chua chay is vegetarian sour soup, usually with tamarind, pineapple, tomato, okra, herbs, tofu, and rice.
usually_includes: tamarind sour broth | pineapple | tomato | okra or bạc hà | tofu and herbs
good_to_know: Ask whether the sour broth uses vegetarian seasoning; fish sauce can appear quietly in mixed kitchens.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh chua chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of vegetarian sour soup.

at_a_glance: Lẩu nấm chay is vegetarian mushroom hot pot, usually with mixed mushrooms, tofu, greens, noodles, and vegetable broth.
usually_includes: vegetable broth | mixed mushrooms | tofu | greens | noodles
good_to_know: Ask whether the hot-pot broth is vegetable-based and whether the table dips are vegetarian.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần lẩu nấm chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian mushroom hot pot.

vietnamese_item: Cà tím nướng mỡ hành chay
sound_out: kah teem noong muh hanh chai
at_a_glance: Cà tím nướng mỡ hành chay is grilled eggplant with scallion oil, usually with smoky eggplant, peanuts, soy-lime dip, and herbs.
usually_includes: grilled eggplant | scallion oil | peanuts | soy-lime vegetarian dip | herbs
good_to_know: Mỡ hành should be scallion oil; confirm no pork fat or fish sauce if the stall is not fully vegetarian.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần cà tím nướng mỡ hành chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled eggplant with scallion oil.

at_a_glance: Bún đậu chay is a vegetarian take on the bún đậu platter: rice vermicelli, fried tofu, herbs, vegetables, and a vegetarian soy-lime or fermented-bean dip.
usually_includes: rice vermicelli | fried tofu | fresh herbs | cucumber | vegetarian soy-lime dip
good_to_know: The standard non-vegetarian platter centers mắm tôm and pork. Chay should move it into tofu and a vegetarian mắm-style dip.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bún đậu chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian tofu vermicelli platter.

at_a_glance: Canh chua cá is tamarind-sour fish soup with tomato, pineapple, okra, bạc hà stem, herbs, and a sweet-sour broth eaten with rice.
usually_includes: fish | tamarind broth | pineapple | tomato | okra and herbs
good_to_know: Canh chua means sour soup. The sourness should be refreshing and balanced, not creamy or heavy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh chua cá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of sweet-and-sour fish soup.

at_a_glance: Canh chua tôm is tamarind-sour shrimp soup with pineapple, tomato, okra, herbs, and a bright broth that is usually eaten with rice.
usually_includes: shrimp | tamarind broth | pineapple | tomato | okra and herbs
good_to_know: This is a shared soup, not a noodle soup. The sweet-sour broth is there to wake up rice and other dishes.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh chua tôm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of sweet-and-sour shrimp soup.

english_translation: Bitter melon soup with stuffed pork
at_a_glance: Canh khổ qua nhồi thịt is bitter melon stuffed with pork, usually with clear broth, herbs, and tender filling.
usually_includes: bitter melon | minced pork filling | clear broth | scallions | rice on the side
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh khổ qua nhồi thịt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of bitter melon soup with stuffed pork.

english_translation: Jute leaf soup with field crab
at_a_glance: Canh rau đay cua đồng is jute leaf soup with field crab, usually with soft greens, crab roe, and earthy broth.
usually_includes: jute leaves | field crab | crab roe | green broth | rice on the side
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh rau đay cua đồng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of jute leaf soup with field crab.

at_a_glance: Canh bầu nấu tôm is gourd soup with shrimp, usually with clear broth, soft bầu, shrimp sweetness, and scallion.
usually_includes: bottle gourd | shrimp | clear broth | scallions | rice on the side
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh bầu nấu tôm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of gourd soup with shrimp.

english_translation: Mustard green soup with minced pork
at_a_glance: Canh cải thịt bằm is mustard-green soup with minced pork, usually with peppery greens, clear broth, and rice.
usually_includes: mustard greens | minced pork | clear broth | scallions | rice on the side
good_to_know: May contain pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh cải thịt bằm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of mustard green soup with minced pork.

at_a_glance: Canh bí đao is winter melon soup, usually with clear broth, soft bí đao, pork or shrimp depending on the cook.
usually_includes: clear broth | winter melon | minced pork or shrimp optional | scallions | pepper
good_to_know: Bí đao should taste soft, clean, and cooling in a clear broth. Ask whether pork or shrimp is used if you need a vegetarian bowl.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô canh bí đao.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of winter melon soup.

at_a_glance: Súp măng cua is asparagus crab soup, usually with crab, egg ribbons, asparagus, and pepper.
usually_includes: crab | asparagus | egg ribbons | thickened broth | pepper
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô súp măng cua.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of crab and asparagus soup.

at_a_glance: Súp bí đỏ is pumpkin soup, usually with smooth pumpkin, cream or broth, and gentle sweetness.
usually_includes: pumpkin | cream or light broth | pepper | herbs | small bowl
good_to_know: Pumpkin soup may be a modern café or family-style soup; ask if it contains cream, chicken stock, or seafood stock if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô súp bí đỏ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of pumpkin soup.

at_a_glance: Lẩu Thái is Vietnamese Thai-style hot pot, usually with sour-spicy broth, seafood or meat, greens, and noodles.
usually_includes: sour-spicy broth | seafood or meat | greens | mushrooms | noodles
good_to_know: Choose portion size first, then protein and spice level. Ask for less spice before the broth is set if you want sour lemongrass flavor with less heat.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu Thái.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of Thai-style hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu mắm is Mekong Delta fermented-fish hot pot with seafood, pork, eggplant, and piles of greens. It is a shared-table dish with a deep mắm broth.
usually_includes: fermented fish broth | seafood | pork | eggplant | wild greens
good_to_know: The broth has a strong aroma by design. Order it when the table wants a bold regional hot pot, not a neutral soup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu mắm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of fermented fish hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu cá kèo is goby fish hot pot, usually with sour broth, herbs, fish, and noodles.
usually_includes: cá kèo goby fish | sour broth | rau đắng or greens | herbs | noodles
good_to_know: Cá kèo is small and bony, so eat carefully. The southern pleasure is the sour broth meeting slightly bitter greens.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu cá kèo.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of mudskipper fish hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu cá lóc is snakehead fish hot pot, usually with sour broth, elephant ear stem or herbs, noodles, and fish.
usually_includes: snakehead fish | sour broth | greens | noodles | fish bones possible
good_to_know: Ask about bones before ordering if you prefer easy fish pieces. Add greens and noodles after the fish flavors the sour broth.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu cá lóc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of snakehead fish hot pot.

english_translation: Chicken hot pot with lemon basil
at_a_glance: Lẩu gà lá é is chicken hot pot with peppery lá é herb, often linked with Đà Lạt and Phú Yên. The herb goes in fresh so the broth smells bright.
usually_includes: chicken | lá é herb | sour bamboo shoots | mushrooms | noodles
good_to_know: Lá é is often translated as lemon basil, but its peppery herbal aroma is the point. Add it late so it stays fragrant.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu gà lá é.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of chicken hot pot with lemon basil.

at_a_glance: Lẩu cua đồng is field crab hot pot, usually with crab roe broth, greens, tofu, noodles, and tomatoes.
usually_includes: field-crab roe broth | tofu | tomatoes | greens | noodles
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu cua đồng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of field crab hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu nấm is mushroom hot pot, usually with mixed mushrooms, tofu or vegetables, greens, and clear broth.
usually_includes: mixed mushrooms | hot-pot broth | tofu optional | greens | noodles
good_to_know: The broth may not be vegetarian at mixed restaurants, even when mushrooms are the headline.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu nấm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of mushroom hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu bò is beef hot pot, usually with thin beef, greens, tofu, noodles, and shared broth.
usually_includes: beef slices | hot-pot broth | greens | tofu or mushrooms | noodles
good_to_know: Cook thin beef briefly so it stays tender, then add greens and noodles in later rounds. The pot is meant to stretch over conversation.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of beef hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu hải sản is seafood hot pot, usually with shrimp, squid, fish, greens, mushrooms, and noodles.
usually_includes: shrimp | squid | fish or clams | sour-spicy broth | greens and noodles
good_to_know: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu hải sản.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of seafood hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu cá tầm is sturgeon hot pot, usually with firm fish, sour broth, vegetables, and noodles.
usually_includes: sturgeon | sour broth | greens | noodles | cartilage-rich fish pieces
good_to_know: Sturgeon can have firm flesh and cartilage-rich pieces. Add greens and noodles after the fish has warmed through.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu cá tầm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sturgeon hot pot.

at_a_glance: Lẩu chay is vegetarian hot pot, usually with mushrooms, tofu, greens, noodles, and vegetable broth.
usually_includes: vegetable broth | tofu | mushrooms | greens | noodles
good_to_know: Ask whether the broth and dip are fully vegetarian if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một nồi lẩu chay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of vegetarian hot pot.

at_a_glance: Chè ba màu is the classic three-color dessert cup: beans, pandan jelly, coconut milk, and crushed ice layered so every spoonful changes texture.
usually_includes: mung beans | red beans | pandan jelly | coconut milk | crushed ice
good_to_know: This is as much about texture as sweetness. Stir lightly if you want the coconut milk to reach every layer.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè ba màu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of three-color dessert.

at_a_glance: Chè đậu xanh is mung bean sweet soup or pudding, often soft, lightly sweet, and rounded with coconut milk. It is simple comfort rather than a flashy dessert.
usually_includes: mung beans | sugar | coconut milk optional | ice optional
good_to_know: Đậu xanh means mung bean. Ask for less coconut if you want the bean flavor cleaner.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô chè đậu xanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of mung bean sweet soup.

at_a_glance: Chè đậu đỏ is red bean sweet soup, usually soft beans in syrup with coconut milk or ice. It is earthy, sweet, and filling.
usually_includes: red beans | sugar syrup | coconut milk optional | ice optional
good_to_know: The beans should be tender but still recognizable. Ask for less sweet if you want it lighter.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô chè đậu đỏ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of red bean sweet soup.

at_a_glance: Chè đậu đen is black bean sweet soup, often served with syrup, coconut milk, and ice. It tastes deeper and earthier than red bean chè.
usually_includes: black beans | sugar syrup | coconut milk optional | ice
good_to_know: It is a cooling dessert on hot days. The beans give it more chew and body than a simple pudding.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô chè đậu đen.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bowl of black bean sweet soup.

at_a_glance: Chè bắp is sweet corn pudding, usually made with tender corn, sticky rice or tapioca body, coconut milk, and gentle sweetness.
usually_includes: sweet corn | coconut milk | tapioca or sticky rice | sugar
good_to_know: Bắp means corn. Expect a soft spoon dessert, not a corn drink.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè bắp.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sweet corn pudding.

at_a_glance: Chè chuối is banana coconut pudding with soft banana, coconut milk, tapioca pearls, and often peanuts or sesame on top.
usually_includes: banana | coconut milk | tapioca pearls | peanuts optional | sesame
good_to_know: The banana is usually cooked until soft and fragrant. Ask no peanuts if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè chuối.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of banana coconut pudding.

at_a_glance: Chè Thái is a fruit-and-jelly dessert with coconut milk, often durian, jackfruit, longan, lychee, and colorful jellies. It is creamy, fragrant, and loud in a good way.
usually_includes: coconut milk | fruit | jellies | durian optional | crushed ice
good_to_know: Ask about durian if the aroma worries you. Some cups include it by default; others keep it optional.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè thái.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of Thai-style fruit dessert.

at_a_glance: Chè khúc bạch is a chilled dessert with soft milk-jelly cubes, lychee or longan, syrup, and sliced almonds. It is lighter and cleaner than coconut-heavy chè.
usually_includes: milk jelly | lychee or longan | clear syrup | almonds | ice
good_to_know: The cubes should be silky and lightly creamy, not chewy like tapioca. It is a good choice when you want a cooler, gentler dessert.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè khúc bạch.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of almond panna cotta dessert.

english_translation: Sticky rice balls in ginger syrup
at_a_glance: Chè trôi nước is warm glutinous rice balls filled with mung bean and served in ginger syrup, often with coconut milk and sesame.
usually_includes: glutinous rice balls | mung bean filling | ginger syrup | coconut milk optional | sesame
good_to_know: This is a warm dessert, not an iced cup. The ginger syrup is part of the comfort.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè trôi nước.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sticky rice balls in ginger syrup.

english_translation: Jelly and faux pomegranate seed dessert
at_a_glance: Chè sương sa hạt lựu is a jelly dessert with agar, coconut milk, and faux pomegranate-seed cubes that pop with chewy texture.
usually_includes: agar jelly | faux pomegranate seeds | coconut milk | ice | syrup
good_to_know: Hạt lựu means pomegranate seeds, but these are usually colorful starch jellies, not real pomegranate.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè sương sa hạt lựu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of jelly and faux pomegranate seed dessert.

at_a_glance: Tàu hũ nước đường is soft tofu pudding in ginger sugar syrup. It is silky, warm or chilled, and gentler than many coconut-heavy desserts.
usually_includes: soft tofu pudding | ginger syrup | sugar syrup | coconut optional
good_to_know: This is dessert tofu, not savory tofu. The texture should be very soft and spoonable.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần tàu hũ nước đường.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of silken tofu with ginger syrup.

at_a_glance: Sương sáo is grass jelly, a dark herbal jelly served with syrup, ice, or milk. It is cooling, lightly bitter, and very soft.
usually_includes: grass jelly | syrup | ice | milk optional
good_to_know: The flavor is herbal rather than fruity. Choose it when you want something cooling and not too rich.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần sương sáo.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grass jelly.

at_a_glance: Bánh flan is Vietnamese caramel flan, usually silky custard with dark caramel and sometimes crushed ice or coffee.
usually_includes: egg custard | caramel | crushed ice optional | coffee optional
good_to_know: Some shops serve flan with coffee poured over ice. Ask if you want it plain.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh flan.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of caramel flan.

at_a_glance: Rau câu dừa is coconut jelly, often layered with clear coconut water jelly and creamy coconut milk jelly.
usually_includes: coconut jelly | coconut water | coconut milk | agar
good_to_know: Rau câu means agar jelly. It should be clean, cool, and sliceable.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần rau câu dừa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of coconut jelly.

at_a_glance: Kem dừa is coconut ice cream, often served in a coconut shell or cup with coconut flakes, peanuts, or jelly toppings.
usually_includes: coconut ice cream | coconut flakes | peanuts optional | jelly optional
good_to_know: Ask no peanuts if needed. The best versions taste like coconut, not just vanilla with coconut bits.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly kem dừa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of coconut ice cream.

english_translation: Layered pandan and mung bean cake
at_a_glance: Bánh da lợn is a layered steamed cake, usually pandan-green and mung-bean-yellow, with a chewy tapioca-rice texture and gentle coconut sweetness.
usually_includes: tapioca-rice batter | pandan | mung bean | coconut milk | steamed layers
good_to_know: The name means pig-skin cake because of the layered texture, not because it contains pork.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh da lợn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of layered pandan and mung bean cake.

at_a_glance: Bánh chuối nướng is baked banana cake, often dense, coconut-rich, and caramelized at the edges.
usually_includes: banana | coconut milk | bread or starch base | sugar
good_to_know: This is not fluffy American banana bread. Expect a moist, custardy texture.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh chuối nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of baked banana cake.

at_a_glance: Bánh bò is honeycomb cake, a chewy steamed or baked rice cake with airy tunnels and gentle coconut sweetness.
usually_includes: rice flour | tapioca starch | coconut milk | yeast or leavening
good_to_know: The honeycomb texture is the point. It should bounce a little when you bite it.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh bò.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of honeycomb cake.

at_a_glance: Bánh cam is a fried sesame ball with a crisp chewy shell and sweet mung bean filling. It is snacky, round, and best fresh.
usually_includes: glutinous rice shell | mung bean filling | sesame | fried crust
good_to_know: The outside should be crisp-chewy while the filling stays soft. Freshness matters.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh cam.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of sesame ball.

at_a_glance: Bánh pía is a flaky southern pastry, often from Sóc Trăng, filled with mung bean, salted egg yolk, and sometimes durian.
usually_includes: flaky pastry | mung bean filling | salted egg yolk | durian optional
good_to_know: Ask about durian before buying if the aroma is a concern. The pastry can be rich and sweet-salty.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh pía.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of durian mung bean pastry.

at_a_glance: Chuối nếp nướng is grilled banana wrapped in sticky rice, usually served with coconut sauce, peanuts, and sesame. It is smoky, chewy, and sweet.
usually_includes: banana | sticky rice | coconut sauce | peanuts | sesame
good_to_know: The grilled wrapper gives a toasty edge while the coconut sauce makes it dessert-rich.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chuối nếp nướng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of grilled banana with sticky rice.

at_a_glance: Bánh cốm is green young-rice cake, usually sticky and fragrant with mung bean filling. It is closely tied to Hanoi gift culture.
usually_includes: young green rice | mung bean filling | sugar | pandan-like aroma
good_to_know: Cốm means young green rice flakes. The texture is sticky and chewy, not fluffy cake.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh cốm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of green rice flakes cake.

at_a_glance: Bánh phu thê is a translucent chewy cake with mung bean and coconut, often wrapped for weddings or gifts.
usually_includes: tapioca-like wrapper | mung bean | coconut | sugar
good_to_know: The name means husband-and-wife cake. It is symbolic as much as snackable.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh phu thê.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of husband-and-wife cake.

at_a_glance: Sữa chua nếp cẩm is yogurt with fermented black sticky rice. It is tangy, creamy, gently boozy-smelling, and chewy from the rice.
usually_includes: yogurt | black sticky rice | fermented rice syrup | ice optional
good_to_know: The black sticky rice brings a fermented aroma and chew. It is dessert, not just a yogurt cup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa chua nếp cẩm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of yogurt with black sticky rice.

at_a_glance: Trái cây dĩa is a mixed fruit plate, usually fresh cut fruit served cold with salt-chili dip, yogurt, or syrup depending on the shop.
usually_includes: fresh fruit | ice optional | salt-chili dip optional | yogurt optional
good_to_know: Dĩa means plate. Ask what fruit is included if you are avoiding durian, jackfruit, or anything very ripe.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần trái cây dĩa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one order of mixed fruit plate.

at_a_glance: Kem bơ is avocado ice cream or avocado cream, famously associated with Đà Lạt-style dessert shops. It is creamy, green, and richer than a fruit smoothie.
usually_includes: avocado | ice cream | condensed milk | coconut optional
good_to_know: Bơ means avocado here, not butter. Expect dessert creaminess rather than a savory avocado flavor.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly kem bơ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of avocado ice cream.

at_a_glance: Cà phê sữa đá is Vietnam’s iconic iced milk coffee, balancing dark robusta bite with condensed milk and a hard chill from the ice.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | condensed milk | ice
good_to_know: Strong and sweet; ask for less condensed milk or more ice if you want it lighter.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê sữa đá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of Vietnamese iced milk coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê đen đá is the stripped-down iced robusta order, bold, bitter-edged, and slowly softened by ice at sidewalk coffee tables.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | ice
good_to_know: It can be much stronger than a typical iced Americano.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê đen đá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of Vietnamese iced black coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê sữa nóng is hot phin coffee over condensed milk, sweet, fragrant, and stronger than its creamy look suggests.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | condensed milk
good_to_know: Sweetness is built in; ask for less milk if the café can adjust it.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê sữa nóng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of hot Vietnamese milk coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê đen nóng is a small hot cup of Vietnamese robusta, smoky, concentrated, and meant for slow sipping rather than quick gulping.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter
good_to_know: Ask for sugar separately if you do not want it sweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê đen nóng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of hot black coffee.

at_a_glance: Bạc xỉu is southern coffee comfort, with more milk than coffee and a creamy sweetness for people who want aroma without the full robusta punch.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | condensed milk | fresh milk | ice optional
good_to_know: It is usually sweet and gentle, not a strong coffee order.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly bạc xỉu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of light milk coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê trứng is Hanoi egg coffee, with strong robusta under whipped egg cream and a 1946 milk-shortage story behind the cup.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | egg cream | condensed milk
good_to_know: Contains egg and is rich enough to treat like dessert. Served hot, it shows the Hanoi origin best because the egg cream stays thick and warm.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê trứng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of egg coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê cốt dừa turns strong Vietnamese coffee into a coconut-cream café treat, cold, rich, and especially welcome in beach-city heat.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | coconut cream | ice
good_to_know: Usually sweet and creamy; ask before ordering if you avoid dairy or coconut cream.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê cốt dừa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of coconut coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê muối is Huế-style coffee creativity in a glass, using salted cream to make condensed-milk sweetness taste deeper and almost caramel-like.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | salted cream | condensed milk
good_to_know: It should taste gently salty, not briny.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê muối.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of salt coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê phin is the slow metal-filter ritual behind many Vietnamese coffee orders, letting a strong cup change drip by drip.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter
good_to_know: Ask whether it comes black or with condensed milk.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê phin.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of Vietnamese drip coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê sữa tươi is fresh-milk coffee for a cleaner dairy finish, a modern alternative to Vietnam’s heavier condensed-milk style.
usually_includes: robusta coffee | phin filter | fresh milk | ice optional
good_to_know: Still ask about sugar; fresh milk does not always mean unsweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê sữa tươi.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of coffee with fresh milk.

at_a_glance: Cà phê đá xay belongs to Vietnam’s newer café style, blending coffee, ice, and milk into a cold shake while keeping a roasted coffee edge.
usually_includes: coffee | ice | milk or cream | sugar optional
good_to_know: Often sweet, cold, and filling.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê đá xay.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of blended iced coffee.

at_a_glance: Cà phê latte sits in Vietnam’s contemporary café lane, softer and milkier than phin coffee but often built on the same local coffee culture.
usually_includes: espresso-style coffee | steamed or fresh milk
good_to_know: Ask whether it is hot or iced; menus can vary.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê latte.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of latte.

at_a_glance: Cà phê espresso is the modern café shortcut for a sharp coffee hit, often still carrying Vietnam’s firm robusta bitterness.
usually_includes: espresso coffee | small cup
good_to_know: It may still use Vietnamese robusta, so expect a firm bitter edge.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê espresso.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of espresso.

at_a_glance: Cà phê mocha is a dessert-leaning café drink where chocolate and milk soften Vietnamese coffee’s roasted bite.
usually_includes: coffee | milk | chocolate
good_to_know: Usually sweet and milky.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly cà phê mocha.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of mocha coffee.

at_a_glance: Trà đá is everyday iced tea, light, plain, and so common in Vietnam that it often appears before you even order.
usually_includes: tea | ice
good_to_know: Usually unsweetened, but bottled versions can be different.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà đá.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of iced tea.

at_a_glance: Trà nóng is hot tea, simple and hospitable, the kind of small cup that anchors meals, homes, and shop counters across Vietnam.
usually_includes: tea
good_to_know: Ask before adding sugar; plain hot tea is often served without it.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà nóng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of hot tea.

at_a_glance: Trà xanh is green tea, grassy, lightly bitter, and clean when plain, but often sweetened on bottled or café menus.
usually_includes: green tea | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Ask for no sugar if you want it unsweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà xanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of green tea.

at_a_glance: Trà sen is lotus tea, softly floral and especially tied to northern refinement rather than loud fruit sweetness.
usually_includes: tea | lotus scent | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually best plain or lightly sweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà sen.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of lotus tea.

at_a_glance: Trà lài is jasmine tea, fragrant and clean, part of the Vietnamese habit of using tea for welcome, pause, and conversation.
usually_includes: jasmine tea | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Can be plain or sweetened depending on the shop.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà lài.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of jasmine tea.

at_a_glance: Trà gừng is ginger tea for warmth and comfort, spicy in the throat, lightly sweet, and especially welcome after rain or heavy food.
usually_includes: ginger | tea or hot water | sugar or honey optional
good_to_know: Ask about sugar if you want it less sweet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà gừng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of ginger tea.

at_a_glance: Trà tắc is kumquat iced tea, sharp, citrusy, lightly bitter from the peel, and very Vietnamese as a street-café cooler.
usually_includes: tea | kumquat | ice | sugar
good_to_know: Usually sweet unless you ask otherwise.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà tắc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of kumquat iced tea.

at_a_glance: Trà chanh is lemon tea with a Hanoi street-hangout feeling, tart, sweet, icy, and made for low stools and long chats.
usually_includes: tea | lemon or lime | ice | sugar
good_to_know: Sweetness can be high by default.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà chanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of lemon tea.

at_a_glance: Trà đào is peach tea, fragrant and sweet over ice, a modern café favorite rather than an old ritual tea.
usually_includes: tea | peach | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually sweet and not the same as plain tea.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà đào.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of peach tea.

at_a_glance: Trà vải is lychee tea, floral, sweet, and cooling, a modern café drink where fruit perfume matters as much as tea.
usually_includes: tea | lychee | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: May include canned lychee, syrup, or jelly depending on the café.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà vải.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of lychee tea.

at_a_glance: Trà sữa is Vietnam’s youth-café milk tea lane, creamy, sweet, tannic, and ordered by sugar, ice, and toppings.
usually_includes: tea | milk | sugar | ice
good_to_know: Ask for less sugar if you do not want it dessert-sweet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà sữa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of milk tea.

at_a_glance: Trà sữa trân châu adds chewy pearls to milk tea, making texture just as important as sweetness or tea flavor.
usually_includes: tea | milk | tapioca pearls | ice | sugar
good_to_know: The pearls make it filling.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà sữa trân châu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of bubble milk tea.

at_a_glance: Trà ô long is oolong tea, roasted, honeyed, or floral depending on the brew, and useful when plain tea still wants aroma.
usually_includes: oolong tea | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Ask whether it is plain tea or a sweet café drink.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà ô long.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of oolong tea.

at_a_glance: Trà atiso is Đà Lạt artichoke tea, earthy, gently sweet, and tied to the highland city’s cool-weather produce culture.
usually_includes: artichoke tea | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Can be naturally sweet or sweetened, depending on the shop.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà atiso.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of artichoke tea.

at_a_glance: Trà bí đao is winter melon tea, dark, mellow, caramel-like, and part of Vietnam’s cooling herbal drink tradition.
usually_includes: winter melon tea | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Bí đao is winter melon, not peach.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà bí đao.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of winter melon tea.

at_a_glance: Trà hoa cúc is chrysanthemum tea, floral and gentle, often chosen when you want a calming herbal cup instead of caffeine punch.
usually_includes: chrysanthemum tea | hot water or ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Often lightly sweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly trà hoa cúc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of chrysanthemum tea.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố bơ is Vietnam’s famous avocado smoothie, thick and creamy with condensed milk turning a savory fruit into dessert.
usually_includes: avocado | condensed milk | ice | milk optional
good_to_know: Rich and filling enough to count as a snack.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố bơ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of avocado smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố xoài is mango smoothie, thick, golden, tropical, and one of the easiest Vietnamese fruit drinks to fall for.
usually_includes: mango | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Can be very sweet with condensed milk.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố xoài.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of mango smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố dâu is strawberry smoothie, pink, creamy, sweet-tart, and a common fruit-café order in Vietnam.
usually_includes: strawberry | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually sweeter and milkier than a fruit juice.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố dâu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of strawberry smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố chuối is banana smoothie comfort, creamy and familiar, but usually sweeter and colder in Vietnamese café style.
usually_includes: banana | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Good when you want a less tart fruit drink.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố chuối.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of banana smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố mãng cầu is soursop smoothie, tangy, creamy, fragrant, and one of the more exciting tropical fruit drinks for visitors.
usually_includes: soursop | ice | condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: The texture can be thick and pulpy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố mãng cầu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of soursop smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố dừa is coconut smoothie, rich and icy with a creamy tropical body that feels made for Vietnamese heat.
usually_includes: coconut | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Ask about dairy if you avoid milk or condensed milk.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố dừa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of coconut smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố sapôchê uses sapodilla for a brown-sugar, pear-like smoothie that many visitors have never tasted before Vietnam.
usually_includes: sapodilla | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually sweet even before added sugar.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố sapôchê.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sapodilla smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố thanh long turns dragon fruit into a pale, speckled smoothie, mild, cooling, and gentle beside stronger tropical fruits.
usually_includes: dragon fruit | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Milder than mango or passion fruit.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố thanh long.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of dragon fruit smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố chanh dây blends passion fruit into a tart, floral smoothie that keeps its bright tropical perfume even with milk and ice.
usually_includes: passion fruit | ice | sugar | milk optional
good_to_know: Seeds or pulp may be part of the texture.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố chanh dây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of passion fruit smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố dưa hấu is watermelon blended into a cold, light smoothie that stays more refreshing than creamy.
usually_includes: watermelon | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Much lighter than avocado or coconut smoothies.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố dưa hấu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of watermelon smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố mít is jackfruit smoothie, bold, honeyed, tropical, and aromatic enough that you smell the fruit before you sip.
usually_includes: jackfruit | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: The flavor is strong and sweet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố mít.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of jackfruit smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố đu đủ turns papaya into a mellow orange smoothie, tropical, soft, and gently musky when the fruit is ripe.
usually_includes: papaya | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Ask for less sugar if you prefer papaya’s natural sweetness.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố đu đủ.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of papaya smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố trái cây is the mixed-fruit smoothie wildcard, where the stall’s ripe fruit, condensed milk, and ice decide the cup.
usually_includes: mixed fruit | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Flavor changes by shop and season.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố trái cây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of mixed fruit smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố rau má blends pennywort into a thicker green drink, cooling and grassy but softer than straight rau má juice.
usually_includes: pennywort | water or ice | sugar optional | mung bean optional
good_to_know: The grassy flavor can surprise first-timers.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố rau má.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of pennywort smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố việt quất is blueberry smoothie, more modern café than old street stall, sweet, creamy, and familiar for travelers.
usually_includes: blueberry | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually familiar but sweet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố việt quất.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of blueberry smoothie.

at_a_glance: Sinh tố đào is peach smoothie, soft, fragrant, and often more café-style than traditional street juice.
usually_includes: peach | ice | milk or condensed milk | sugar optional
good_to_know: May taste more like peach syrup than fresh fruit depending on the café.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sinh tố đào.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of peach smoothie.

at_a_glance: Nước mía is fresh sugarcane pressed to order, grassy, sweet, icy, and lifted by kumquat or lime at sidewalk machines.
usually_includes: sugarcane juice | ice | kumquat or lime
good_to_know: Best fresh and very cold.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước mía.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sugarcane juice.

at_a_glance: Nước cam is fresh orange juice as Vietnamese stalls often serve it, bright, pulpy, sweet-tart, and adjustable by sugar and ice.
usually_includes: orange | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Sugar and ice are the two useful adjustments.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước cam.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of orange juice.

at_a_glance: Nước chanh is Vietnam’s hot-day limeade, sharp with fresh lime, sweetened to order, and usually poured over plenty of ice.
usually_includes: lime | water | sugar | ice
good_to_know: Usually sweet unless you ask.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước chanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of limeade.

at_a_glance: Chanh muối uses preserved salted lime for a sour-salty-sweet drink that feels more like Vietnamese refreshment than ordinary lemonade.
usually_includes: salted preserved lime | water | sugar | ice
good_to_know: The salty preserved-lime flavor may surprise you.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chanh muối.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of salted lime drink.

at_a_glance: Nước dừa is young coconut water, clean and lightly sweet, a simple taste of tropical Vietnam at markets, beaches, and roadside stalls.
usually_includes: fresh coconut water | coconut flesh optional | ice optional
good_to_know: Usually not as sweet as bottled coconut drinks.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước dừa.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of fresh coconut water.

at_a_glance: Nước ép dưa hấu is watermelon juice for humid days, light, juicy, softly sweet, and usually best when freshly blended.
usually_includes: watermelon | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Best cold and freshly blended.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép dưa hấu.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of watermelon juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép thơm is pineapple juice with tropical bite, golden sweetness, and enough tartness to stay refreshing in Vietnamese heat.
usually_includes: pineapple | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Can be tart.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép thơm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of pineapple juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép ổi is guava juice, pale, fragrant, sweet-tart, and sometimes lightly gritty in the way fresh guava should be.
usually_includes: guava | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: May be pulpy or lightly grainy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép ổi.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of guava juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép cà rốt is carrot juice from the fresh-juice stall world, earthy, orange, softly sweet, and often mellowed with sugar or milk.
usually_includes: carrot | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Earthier than fruit juice.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép cà rốt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of carrot juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép táo is a familiar café juice option, crisp and mild, useful when a traveler wants something simple on a Vietnamese drink menu.
usually_includes: apple | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: May be sweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép táo.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of apple juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép cần tây is celery juice from Vietnam’s health-drink café lane, green, herbal, lightly bitter, and best ordered with sugar in mind.
usually_includes: celery | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Expect a vegetal flavor.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép cần tây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of celery juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép cóc introduces ambarella, a tart green Vietnamese snack fruit that becomes fragrant, punchy juice over ice.
usually_includes: ambarella | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Tart and unfamiliar for many visitors.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép cóc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of ambarella juice.

at_a_glance: Nước ép chanh dây turns passion fruit into a bright Vietnamese café drink, tangy, floral, aromatic, and vivid over ice.
usually_includes: passion fruit | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Seeds or pulp may be included.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước ép chanh dây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of passion fruit juice.

at_a_glance: Rau má is pennywort juice, green, grassy, and cooling, a Vietnamese drink that can feel both herbal and refreshingly alive.
usually_includes: pennywort | water | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: The green flavor is strong.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly rau má.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of pennywort juice.

at_a_glance: Nước sâm is a cooling herbal drink, dark and gently sweet, built from roots, leaves, and Vietnam’s practical hot-weather drinking habits.
usually_includes: herbal infusion | sugar | ice | dried roots or leaves
good_to_know: Usually sweet.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước sâm.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of herbal drink.

at_a_glance: Nước nha đam is aloe vera drink, lightly sweet with slippery aloe cubes that make texture part of the refreshment.
usually_includes: aloe vera | sugar syrup | water | ice
good_to_know: The aloe texture is slippery and soft.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước nha đam.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of aloe vera drink.

at_a_glance: Sâm bổ lượng is a sweet herbal dessert drink, cooling, chewy, and full of longan, seaweed, barley, or other spoonable textures.
usually_includes: herbal syrup | dried longan | lotus seed optional | seaweed optional | ice
good_to_know: Expect bits and textures in the cup.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sâm bổ lượng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sweet herbal dessert drink.

at_a_glance: Nước la hán quả is a dark monk-fruit herbal drink, naturally sweet, cooling, and part of Vietnam’s old-school refreshment culture.
usually_includes: monk fruit | herbal infusion | ice | sugar optional
good_to_know: Usually sweet but not fizzy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước la hán quả.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of monk fruit herbal drink.

at_a_glance: Nước suối is sealed bottled water, the practical travel-day order when you want plain water with no glass of ice.
usually_includes: bottled water | sealed bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Check the seal if buying from a small stall.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước suối.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of bottled water.

at_a_glance: Nước lọc is plain drinking water, often filtered by the glass, so sealed-bottle travelers may want nước suối instead.
usually_includes: drinking water | glass or pitcher | ice optional
good_to_know: For sealed bottled water, nước suối may be clearer.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước lọc.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of drinking water.

at_a_glance: Nước khoáng is mineral water, a practical menu word to know because still and sparkling bottles may both appear.
usually_includes: mineral water | bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Ask if it is chilled.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước khoáng.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of mineral water.

at_a_glance: Nước khoáng có ga is sparkling mineral water, dry and bubbly, with có ga giving you the carbonated clue.
usually_includes: sparkling mineral water | bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Có ga means carbonated.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước khoáng có ga.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of sparkling mineral water.

at_a_glance: Nước khoáng không ga is still mineral water, clean and bubble-free, with không ga telling you there is no fizz.
usually_includes: still mineral water | bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Không ga means not carbonated.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước khoáng không ga.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of still mineral water.

at_a_glance: Soda chanh is lime soda, fizzy, sharp, sweet, and a classic Vietnamese café answer to hot weather.
usually_includes: soda water | lime | sugar syrup | ice
good_to_know: Usually sweet and fizzy.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly soda chanh.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of lime soda.

at_a_glance: Soda chanh dây is passion-fruit soda, bubbly, tart, floral, and built for a cold café glass.
usually_includes: soda water | passion fruit | sugar syrup | ice
good_to_know: Seeds or pulp may appear.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly soda chanh dây.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of passion fruit soda.

at_a_glance: Soda bạc hà is bright mint soda from Vietnam’s playful café menu world, fizzy, green, sweet, and cooling.
usually_includes: soda water | mint syrup | ice | lime optional
good_to_know: Often syrupy and brightly colored.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly soda bạc hà.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of mint soda.

at_a_glance: Nước ngọt is the Vietnamese catch-all for soft drinks, sweet, fizzy, and usually served cold or over ice.
usually_includes: soft drink | can or bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: May come with a glass of ice.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước ngọt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of soft drink.

at_a_glance: Nước tăng lực is energy drink, sweet, caffeinated, intense, and common at convenience stores and late-night food stops.
usually_includes: energy drink | can or bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Contains caffeine and lots of sugar.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước tăng lực.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of energy drink.

at_a_glance: Sữa đậu nành is soy milk, nutty, soft, and familiar at breakfast stalls, markets, and bakeries.
usually_includes: soy milk | sugar optional | ice optional
good_to_know: Ask about sugar if you want it plain.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa đậu nành.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of soy milk.

at_a_glance: Sữa bắp is corn milk, sweet and creamy, showing Vietnam’s habit of turning grains and vegetables into gentle drinks.
usually_includes: corn | milk | sugar | ice optional
good_to_know: Usually sweet and dairy-like.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa bắp.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of corn milk.

at_a_glance: Sữa tươi is fresh milk on Vietnamese menus, often sweetened unless you ask for no sugar.
usually_includes: fresh milk | carton or glass | ice optional
good_to_know: No sugar means unsweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa tươi.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of fresh milk.

at_a_glance: Sữa chua uống is drinking yogurt, tangy, sweet, and refreshing in the Vietnamese snack-drink lane.
usually_includes: drinking yogurt | bottle or cup | sugar
good_to_know: Usually sweetened.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly sữa chua uống.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of drinking yogurt.

at_a_glance: Nước yến is bird’s nest drink, lightly sweet and silky, prized in Vietnam more for texture and nourishment than bold flavor.
usually_includes: bird’s nest drink | sugar syrup | soft strands | bottle or can
good_to_know: Texture can be unusual if you have never tried bird’s nest.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai nước yến.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of bird's nest drink.

at_a_glance: Bia hơi is fresh draft beer for sidewalk social drinking, light, low-cost, and meant to be poured and finished quickly.
usually_includes: fresh draft beer | chilled glass | ice optional
good_to_know: Alcoholic and usually light-bodied.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly bia hơi.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of fresh draft beer.

at_a_glance: Bia Sài Gòn is a crisp southern lager for seafood, grilled food, and casual tables where beer often arrives with ice.
usually_includes: beer | chilled bottle or can
good_to_know: Alcoholic; beer may arrive with ice.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai bia Sài Gòn.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of Saigon beer.

at_a_glance: Bia Hà Nội is a northern lager tied to the capital’s beer tables, clean, gently bitter, and usually poured very cold.
usually_includes: beer | chilled bottle or can
good_to_know: Alcoholic; ask for no ice if needed.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai bia Hà Nội.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of Hanoi beer.

at_a_glance: Bia Tiger is a familiar Southeast Asian lager widely available in Vietnam, useful when you want a straightforward cold beer.
usually_includes: beer | chilled bottle or can
good_to_know: Alcoholic.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một chai bia Tiger.
quick_say_english: I’d like one bottle of tiger beer.

at_a_glance: Rượu nếp is sticky-rice liquor, warm with grain aroma, sweet at first, and stronger than many visitors expect.
usually_includes: alcohol | glass or bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Alcoholic and can be strong.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly rượu nếp.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of sticky rice wine.

at_a_glance: Rượu đế is Vietnamese rice liquor, clear, fiery, rustic, and meant for small shared pours with food.
usually_includes: rice liquor | small glass | shared bottle
good_to_know: Alcoholic and strong.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly rượu đế.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of Vietnamese rice liquor.

at_a_glance: Rượu vang Đà Lạt is wine from Vietnam’s cool highlands, light, fruity, and tied to Đà Lạt’s unusual climate.
usually_includes: alcohol | glass or bottle | ice optional
good_to_know: Alcoholic; style and sweetness vary by bottle.
quick_say_vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly rượu vang Đà Lạt.
quick_say_english: I’d like one glass of dalat wine.
